note: L2 — framework-neutral component catalogue for the Flare IM UI Kit. Each component is one contract (props/states/events + host-owned data source), realised natively per platform. Grounded in the current @flare-im/vue-ui reference implementation (props/events extracted from source).

contentTypes.note: MessageBubble/MessageContentView dispatch body rendering to a per-content-type view via a registry. Products register new types here.

capabilityFields.supportsConfiguration: Derived from public props and events.
capabilityFields.supportsCustomActions: The public contract accepts host-owned action items or action extensions.
capabilityFields.supportsCustomContent: The public contract accepts host-owned renderers, content, or replaceable regions.
capabilityFields.supportsSlots: At least one platform exposes a targeted slot, builder, composable lambda, or ViewBuilder.
capabilityFields.supportsCapabilities: Business availability is supplied through a capability contract instead of inferred by the view.
capabilityFields.supportsResponsive: The component changes presentation at real container breakpoints while preserving semantics.
capabilityFields.supportsDensity: The component takes a density of its own (its prop says what the values mean); the kit has no global density scale.

description.en: Conversation semantics used to choose the default preset.

description.en: Host-formatted stable secondary line.
description.zh: 由宿主格式化的稳定副标题。

description.en: Direct or group avatar URL.
description.zh: 单聊或群聊头像 URL。

description.en: Presence supplied by the host.
description.zh: 由宿主提供的在线态。

description.zh: 稳定宿主优先级。

description.zh: 保留上下文时的可用性。

description.en: Optional compact badge.

description.en: Host-defined intent payload key.
description.zh: 宿主定义的意图载荷键。

description.zh: 显示所需能力 id。

description.en: Localized accessible label override.
description.zh: 本地化无障碍标签覆盖。

description.zh: 使动作成为开关；为 true 时显示为按下（搜索已打开、详情已显示）。

description.en: Stable id, reported when selected.
description.zh: 稳定 id，被选中时回报。

description.en: Visible label.
description.zh: 可见文案。

description.en: Semantic kit icon name (Vue also accepts a glyph component).
description.zh: 组件库语义图标名（Vue 也接受图标组件）。

description.en: Menus draw a separator where the group changes.
description.zh: 分组变化处菜单画分隔线。

description.en: Priority used by producers that sort; menus keep host order.
description.zh: 供排序方使用的优先级；菜单保持宿主顺序。

description.en: False hides the action.
description.zh: 为 false 时不显示。

description.en: False keeps the action visible but unavailable.
description.zh: 为 false 时保留显示但不可用。

description.en: Compact trailing text.
description.zh: 紧凑的尾部文字。

description.en: Host-defined intent payload key.
description.zh: 宿主定义的意图载荷键。

description.en: Localized accessible name override.
description.zh: 本地化无障碍名称覆盖。

description.en: Why the action is unavailable; shown and announced with it.
description.zh: 不可用的原因；随条目显示并播报。

description.en: Set to make the action a toggle; true draws it on (a pressed button, a checked menu item).
description.zh: 设置后操作为开关；true 表示开启（按下的按钮、勾选的菜单项）。

description.zh: 破坏性操作：用错误文字色绘制。

summary.zh: 由时间线计算的同发送者消息组位置。

summary.en: The action capabilities declared by the host for one conversation context.
summary.zh: 宿主为一个会话上下文声明的动作能力。

description.en: Allowed semantic action or capability ids; omitted means preset actions remain available.
description.zh: 允许的语义动作或能力 id；省略时保留预设动作。

summary.en: Host policy layered over the direct or group header preset without boolean feature flags.
summary.zh: 覆盖在单聊或群聊头部预设上的宿主策略，不使用布尔功能开关。

description.en: Start from no preset actions.
description.zh: 不使用任何预设动作作为起点。

description.en: Permanently remove preset or host actions by id.
description.zh: 按 id 永久移除预设或宿主动作。

description.en: Override labels, icons, placement, state, or order by stable id.
description.zh: 按稳定 id 覆盖文案、图标、位置、状态或顺序。

description.en: Desktop primary toolbar limit before More.
description.zh: 桌面进入 More 前的主工具栏上限。

description.en: Compact primary toolbar limit before More.
description.zh: 紧凑模式进入 More 前的主工具栏上限。

summary.en: The two ids a message row answers to. Locating a message (a quote tap, a pinned bar, a search hit) matches either.
summary.zh: 一行消息认的两个 id。定位一条消息（点引用、置顶栏、搜索命中）两个都算命中。

description.en: The id the list draws the row with and every message intent carries. Vue derives it (`clientMsgId || serverId`); the native kits take it as `FlareMessageData.id`.
description.zh: 列表画这一行用的 id，也是所有消息意图携带的 id。Vue 由 `clientMsgId || serverId` 推出，三个原生 kit 就是 `FlareMessageData.id`。

description.en: The core's id for the same message, when it has one. A quote names the message it quotes by this id, because it is the one every other client knows; a message still on its way has none.
description.zh: 同一条消息在核心里的 id（有的话）。引用用它指向被引用消息——那是别的客户端唯一认得的 id；还在路上的消息没有。

summary.en: Timeline-derived presentation context consumed by a message bubble.
summary.zh: 由时间线推导、供消息气泡消费的呈现上下文。

description.en: Render the sender avatar for this row.
description.zh: 为当前行渲染发送者头像。

description.en: Keep the group gutter stable when the avatar is hidden.
description.zh: 头像隐藏时仍保持消息组边槽稳定。

description.en: Render the group sender name for this row.
description.zh: 为当前行渲染群聊发送者名称。

description.en: Logical avatar side for incoming or optional self avatars.
description.zh: 接收方或可选本人头像的逻辑侧。

description.en: Draw the bubble tail: a bubble surface ending its run (spec/message-grouping-vectors.json).
description.zh: 画气泡尾角：bubble 表面且是本组最后一条（spec/message-grouping-vectors.json）。

summary.en: A directory contact.
summary.zh: 通讯录联系人。

description.en: Stable unique id.
description.zh: 稳定唯一 id。

description.en: Display name.
description.zh: 显示名。

description.en: Avatar image URL; falls back to initials when absent.
description.zh: 头像图 URL；缺省时回退首字母。

description.en: Personal bio / signature line.
description.zh: 个性签名。

description.en: Presence state shown as a status dot.
description.zh: 在线状态，显示为状态圆点。

description.en: Explicit A–Z index letter; derived from name when absent.
description.zh: 显式 A–Z 索引字母；缺省时由名字推导。

summary.en: An incoming friend/contact request.
summary.zh: 收到的好友申请。

description.en: Request id.
description.zh: 申请 id。

description.en: Requester display name.
description.zh: 申请人显示名。

description.en: Requester avatar URL.
description.zh: 申请人头像 URL。

description.en: Optional greeting attached to the request.
description.zh: 申请附言（可选）。

description.en: Where the request came from, already worded by the host ("Added from a contact card, shared by X"); drawn as its own secondary line under the message.
description.zh: 申请来源，宿主已组织好文案（如「通过名片添加，由 X 推荐」）；在验证消息下方单独一行，用次要文本显示。

description.en: Whether the viewer received or sent the request; defaults to incoming.
description.zh: 申请是收到的还是发出的；默认收到。

summary.en: A group shown in a group list.
summary.zh: 群组列表中的群摘要。

description.en: Group id.
description.zh: 群 id。

description.en: Group name.
description.zh: 群名。

description.en: Group avatar URL.
description.zh: 群头像 URL。

description.en: Member count shown as a subtitle.
description.zh: 成员数，作为副标题显示。

summary.en: The signed-in user's profile.
summary.zh: 当前登录用户的资料。

description.en: User id.
description.zh: 用户 id。

description.en: Display name.
description.zh: 显示名。

description.en: Avatar URL.
description.zh: 头像 URL。

description.en: Bio / signature line.
description.zh: 个性签名。

description.en: Optional external/business id shown on the profile.
description.zh: 可选的外部/业务号，展示在资料页。

summary.en: One row in a settings section.
summary.zh: 设置分组中的一行。

description.en: Stable row key emitted on interaction.
description.zh: 稳定行键，交互时回传。

description.en: Row label.
description.zh: 行标题。

description.en: Leading icon: a semantic name from the shared registry (an unknown name draws the registry's fallback glyph).
description.zh: 前置图标：共享注册表里的语义名（未知名画注册表的兜底字形）。

description.en: Row kind: navigation opens a page or picker (chevron), toggle is a switch, action runs in place (no chevron), value is read-only information and not a control.
description.zh: 行类型：navigation 打开页面或选择器（带箭头），toggle 是开关，action 原地执行（无箭头），value 是只读信息、不是控件。

description.en: Toggle state (for `kind: "toggle"`).
description.zh: 开关状态（`kind: "toggle"` 时）。

description.en: Trailing detail text: the current value of a navigation row, or the information of a value row. Long text stacks under the label.
description.zh: 尾部详情文本：navigation 行的当前值，或 value 行的信息。过长时换到标签下方。

summary.en: A titled group of settings rows.
summary.zh: 带标题的设置分组。

description.en: Optional section header.
description.zh: 分组标题（可选）。

description.en: Rows in this section.
description.zh: 分组内的行。

summary.en: Package-owned conversation row view state (no runtime coupling).
summary.zh: 包自有的会话行视图状态（不耦合运行时）。

description.en: Conversation id.
description.zh: 会话 id。

description.en: Conversation title.
description.zh: 会话标题。

description.en: Conversation avatar URL.
description.zh: 会话头像 URL。

description.en: Last-activity timestamp for ordering/time display.
description.zh: 最后活跃时间，用于排序/时间显示。

description.en: Unread badge count.
description.zh: 未读徽标数。

description.en: Rendered last-message preview text.
description.zh: 已渲染的最后一条消息预览文本。

description.en: Preview is still syncing.
description.zh: 预览仍在同步中。

description.en: Unsent draft, rendered as a preview prefix.
description.zh: 未发送草稿，显示为摘要前缀。

description.en: Structured last message (alternative to preview).
description.zh: 结构化最后消息（预览的替代来源）。

description.en: Pinned to the top.
description.zh: 置顶。

description.en: Notifications muted.
description.zh: 已免打扰。

description.en: Archived out of the main list.
description.zh: 已归档。

description.en: Host-formatted locale/timezone-aware timestamp.
description.zh: Host 格式化的时间。

description.en: Unread mention.
description.zh: 有未读提及。

description.en: Typing, below draft and failure priority.
description.zh: 输入中，优先级低于失败和草稿。

description.en: Last send failed, highest preview priority.
description.zh: 最后消息发送失败，摘要最高优先级。

summary.en: A pinned message shown in the pinned bar.
summary.zh: 置顶栏中的置顶消息。

description.en: Server message id.
description.zh: 服务端消息 id。

description.en: Client message id.
description.zh: 客户端消息 id。

description.en: Sender name shown on the pin.
description.zh: 置顶上显示的发送者名。

description.en: Message content used to render the preview.
description.zh: 用于渲染预览的消息内容。

summary.en: One option in a vote/poll message.
summary.zh: 投票消息中的一个选项。

description.en: Option label.
description.zh: 选项文案。

description.zh: 已知的结果百分比（0–100）。没有结果时省略或传 null，不得伪造为零。

summary.en: What a `MediaResolver` receives to produce a displayable URL.
summary.zh: `MediaResolver` 收到的、用于产出可显示 URL 的请求。

description.en: Media kind being resolved.
description.zh: 要解析的媒体类型。

description.en: Owning message id.
description.zh: 所属消息 id。

description.en: Backend file id.
description.zh: 后端文件 id。

description.en: Pre-known URL, if any.
description.zh: 已知 URL（若有）。

description.en: Local cached path, if any.
description.zh: 本地缓存路径（若有）。

description.en: MIME type hint.
description.zh: MIME 类型提示。

description.en: Original file name.
description.zh: 原始文件名。

summary.en: How a settings row renders and behaves.
summary.zh: 设置行的渲染与行为方式。

summary.en: Conversation action ids shared by the row menu, ConversationActionSheet and the action payload on every platform.
summary.zh: 会话行菜单、ConversationActionSheet 与动作载荷在各端共用的会话操作 id。

summary.en: How people join a group. Hosts map their SDK codes to these values; null or nil means the host does not know.
summary.zh: 他人如何加入群。宿主把 SDK 码映射为这些值；null / nil 表示宿主不知道。

summary.en: Conversation-list filter tabs.
summary.zh: 会话列表筛选标签。

summary.en: Composer status driving hints and disabled state.
summary.zh: 输入框状态，驱动提示与禁用。

summary.en: Host-owned availability of the composer's "+" actions and toolbar tools; presentation only, the server still decides what may be sent.
summary.zh: 宿主持有的输入栏「+」动作与工具条工具可用性；只管展示，能否发送仍以服务端为准。

description.en: "+" panel ids to keep; omitted keeps every action.
description.zh: 保留的「+」面板 id；不传时全部保留。

description.en: Toolbar tools to show (emoji, mention, voice, image, richText, attachments — the "+" button); omitted shows every tool, a list shows only the tools it names. SwiftUI spells it availableToolIDs.
description.zh: 要显示的工具条工具（emoji、mention、voice、image、richText、attachments 即「+」按钮）；不传时全部显示，传了只显示列出的工具。SwiftUI 写作 availableToolIDs。

description.en: Whether the conversation supports @ at all (false for a direct chat); Flutter, SwiftUI and Compose take the composer's own mention switch.
description.zh: 会话是否支持 @（单聊为 false）；Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 用输入框自己的提及开关。

summary.en: Where a "+" tile comes from: a built-in feature or an authorised plugin's composer-action; hosts may leave it out for a tile of their own.
summary.zh: 「+」项的来源：内置功能，或已授权插件声明的输入栏入口；宿主自己的项可以不传。

summary.en: Composer toolbar tool ids, the same on all four platforms; attachments is the "+" button.
summary.zh: 输入栏工具条工具 id，四端相同；attachments 即「+」按钮。

summary.en: Media variant a resolver is asked for.
summary.zh: 解析器被请求的媒体变体。

summary.en: Resolved viewport class.
summary.zh: 解析出的视口类别。

summary.en: Layout override mode.
summary.zh: 布局覆盖模式。

summary.en: Result of the host's invite-code pre-check.
summary.zh: 宿主邀请码预检的结果。

description.en: The code can be used to register.
description.zh: 该码可用于注册。

description.en: Masked display name of the inviter the code resolves to.
description.zh: 该码对应邀请人的脱敏显示名。

summary.en: Referral counts per depth for the current person.
summary.zh: 当前用户各深度的推荐人数。

description.en: People who registered with this person's code.
description.zh: 用本人邀请码注册的人数。

description.en: Second-level referrals.
description.zh: 二级推荐人数。

description.en: Third-level referrals.
description.zh: 三级推荐人数。

description.en: Whole team size as the server counts it.
description.zh: 服务端统计的团队总人数。

summary.en: One person invited directly by the current person.
summary.zh: 当前用户直接邀请的一个人。

description.en: Stable identity; echoed by `select` and used as avatar seed.
description.zh: 稳定标识；`select` 回传它，也用作头像种子。

description.en: Display name.
description.zh: 显示名。

description.en: Avatar URL when the host has one.
description.zh: 宿主有头像时的地址。

description.en: Registration time, epoch milliseconds.
description.zh: 注册时间，毫秒时间戳。

summary.en: One reading of a ChartCard series.
summary.zh: ChartCard 序列中的一个读数。

description.en: What the reading is for — a date, a period, a name — already formatted by the host.
description.zh: 读数对应的标签 —— 日期、周期、名称，由宿主格式化好。

description.en: The reading. `null` when there is none for this label (a gap); never substitute zero.
description.zh: 读数。该标签没有读数时传 `null`（缺口），不得用 0 代替。

summary.en: One column of a DataTable.
summary.zh: DataTable 的一列。

description.en: Field of the row this column reads; also names the `cell-<key>` slot.
description.zh: 这一列读取的行字段；也是 `cell-<key>` 插槽的名字。

description.en: Header text; on a narrow container it labels every stacked cell.
description.zh: 表头文字；窄容器下成为每个堆叠单元格的标签。

description.en: Fixed width (a number is px).
description.zh: 固定宽度（数字按 px）。

description.en: Lower bound when the table shares the space out.
description.zh: 表格分配空间时的下限。

description.en: Draw a sort control in the header; the host sorts and passes `sort` back.
description.zh: 表头画出排序控件；排序由宿主执行并回传 `sort`。

description.en: Horizontal alignment of the header and the cells. Default `start`.
description.zh: 表头与单元格的水平对齐。默认 `start`。

description.en: Keep the cell on one line and cut it with an ellipsis; the full text stays in `title`.
description.zh: 单元格保持单行，超出用省略号截断；完整文本放在 `title` 里。

description.zh: 渲染这一列单元格的插槽。默认 `cell-<key>`。

description.en: False keeps the column out of the column chooser: it is always visible. Default true.
description.zh: 为 false 时不进入列设置，始终可见。默认 true。

summary.zh: DataTable 当前显示并上报的排序。

description.zh: 列的 key。

description.zh: 方向。

summary.zh: DataTable 的服务端分页：当前在第几页，以及总共有多少行；游标数据源则是后面是否还有一页。

description.zh: 当前页，从 1 起。

description.zh: 每页行数。

description.zh: 服务端总行数，不是本页行数。游标分页、无法计数的数据源不传。

summary.zh: DescriptionList 的一行「标签 / 值」。

description.zh: 距搜索中心的米数（宿主知道时）；显示为「120m」/「1.2km」。

summary.zh: Vue 时间线在 locationOpen 里回传的位置消息；Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 回传各自的位置内容。

description.zh: WGS-84 纬度（没有时为 NaN）。

description.zh: WGS-84 经度。

description.zh: 地点名。

description.zh: 静态图地址。

description.en: Map service named by the payload, osm when it names none.
description.zh: 载荷里的地图服务，没有时为 osm。

summary.en: One person the contact picker can return.
summary.zh: 联系人选择器可以返回的一个人。

description.zh: 用户 id；名片里带的就是它。

description.zh: 显示名；参与搜索。

description.zh: 头像地址。

description.zh: 副标题（部门、用户名）；参与搜索。

description.zh: 当前登录用户：显示「（我）」，仍可选择。

summary.zh: 联系人选择器的一个标签页。

description.zh: 标签文案；friends、groupMembers 由 Kit 提供。

description.zh: 该标签下的人，按显示顺序。

summary.zh: 解析后的插件视图（核心 SDK 的 ResolvedPluginView）。

fields.name: presentation
fields.type: {renderer: string, props: Record<string, unknown>, actions: Record<string, string>}

description.en: Optional compiled-in Kit composition with bounded resolved display values and references to visible declared actions. Unknown renderers use the document. No network or authorization semantics.
description.zh: 可选的内置 Kit 组合，包含有界的已解析展示值和可见声明动作引用。未知 renderer 使用文档。无网络或权限语义。

description.en: False: only the title shows (disabled plugin, history).
description.zh: 为假时只显示标题（插件停用、历史卡片）。

description.en: Card title.
description.zh: 卡片标题。

description.zh: 展示块，按顺序；不认识的 kind 跳过。

description.zh: 文档的全部输入；动作的 form 列出它要收集的。

description.en: The contribution has a detail view ("see all").
description.zh: 贡献声明了 detail 视图（「查看全部」）。

description.zh: 详情与页面视图：下一页的游标（核心 SDK 分页，非空标量，至多 256 字节）。有值时 PluginDetailSheet 与 PluginPage 提供「加载更多」；宿主取下一页并把合并好的视图传回。

description.en: Actions in the card's ⋯ menu (placement menu), in order; absent when empty.
description.zh: 卡片 ⋯ 菜单里的动作（placement menu），按顺序；为空时不出现。

description.zh: 视图不可用或只读的原因。

summary.zh: 解析后的动作；target 和 input 对 Kit 不透明。

description.zh: 不透明 id，在 action(id, payload) 里回传。

description.zh: 按钮文案。

description.zh: primary 或 danger；不传为次要。

description.zh: 先在 Kit 的 DangerConfirm 里确认的文案。

summary.zh: 动作按钮的样式。

summary.zh: 状态、提示和人员分组的语义色，用 *Text 系列令牌着色。

summary.zh: 一个展示块，按 kind 区分（各自形状见 spec/plugin-view-vectors.json）。

description.zh: 可折叠文本，带「展开」。

description.zh: 键值行。

description.zh: 带色调的提示。

fields.type: {source, columns: {label, format}[], rows: {key, cells: {text, timeMs?}[], actions: {id, input}[], detailInput?, badge?: PluginBadge}[], nextCursor?, actions: PluginAction[], emptyText?, filters?: string[]}

description.zh: page 贡献的 id。

description.zh: 行动作所在的行：key 与视图为该动作绑定的入参（rows[].actions[].input）。

note.zh: toJson() 即请求；有 of(page, view, payload)。

summary.zh: 红包卡片显示的状态（spec/red-packet-vectors.json cardState）。

summary.zh: 插件给出的红包状态（公开层）。

summary.zh: 服务端判定的详情查看者角色。

description.zh: 已领额，最小单位（仅发送人）。

description.zh: 退回额，最小单位（仅发送人）。

description.en: The surface the row draws the content on.

summary.en: One item of the social SDK's features.meMenu, as the kit reads it.
summary.zh: 社交 SDK features.meMenu 的一项，Kit 按此读取。

description.en: A built-in destination or a plugin page entry; other kinds are dropped.
description.zh: 内置入口或插件页面入口；其他 kind 丢掉。

description.en: moments / reports / invite / settings for a built-in item; `plugin:<contributionId>` for a plugin item.
description.zh: 内置项为 moments / reports / invite / settings；插件项为 `plugin:<contributionId>`。

description.en: A kit icon name; another name falls back to plugin.
description.zh: Kit 图标名；不认识的回落到 plugin。

description.en: A plugin item's title.
description.zh: 插件项标题。

description.en: The SDK's sort key; the kit keeps the given order and does not re-sort.
description.zh: SDK 的排序键；Kit 保持给定顺序、不重排。

summary.en: The social SDK's features.meMenu result; flareMeMenuSections(menu, labels, summaries) turns it into SettingsList sections (spec/me-menu-vectors.json).
summary.zh: 社交 SDK features.meMenu 的结果；flareMeMenuSections(menu, labels, summaries) 把它变成 SettingsList 的分组（spec/me-menu-vectors.json）。

description.en: The items in the SDK's order.
description.zh: 按 SDK 顺序的各项。

description.en: False when the switches or the plugin catalog were not read: the host reads again later.
description.zh: 开关或插件目录这次没读到时为 false，宿主稍后重读。

summary.en: One message of a merged-forward record.
summary.zh: 合并转发记录里的一条消息。

description.en: The original sender's name (core sourceSenderName); blank reads as forwardRecordUnknownSender.
description.zh: 原发送者名字（核心 sourceSenderName）；为空写「未知发送者」。

description.en: When the original was sent (core sourceMessageTimeMs).
description.zh: 原消息发送时间（核心 sourceMessageTimeMs）。

description.en: The original's plain text, the preview line when present.
description.zh: 原消息纯文本，有则作摘要行。

description.en: The original content, mapped by the host like any message content.
description.zh: 原消息内容，宿主按普通消息内容映射。

summary.en: A merged-forward record (content type forward, card surface), drawn as Vue ForwardView draws it (spec/message-forward-vectors.json). Vue reads the core payload directly.
summary.zh: 合并转发记录（内容类型 forward，card 表面），按 Vue ForwardView 的形态绘制（spec/message-forward-vectors.json）。Vue 直接读核心载荷。

description.en: The record's own title; blank reads as forwardRecordTitle.
description.zh: 记录自己的标题；为空写「合并转发」。

description.en: The core's ForwardMode (0, 1, 2). One item that is not merged draws inline.
description.zh: 核心 ForwardMode（0、1、2）。只有一条且不是 merged 时直接按那一条渲染。

description.en: The forwarded messages in order.
description.zh: 按顺序的被转发消息。

summary.en: What MessageList builds the long-press sheet and the pointer menu from (native kits).
summary.zh: MessageList 构建长按面板与指针菜单所用的输入（原生 Kit）。

description.en: The host's current snapshot for the message (synchronous).
description.zh: 宿主手里这条消息的当前快照（同步）。

description.en: Rows coming on screen: read their availability ahead of a menu.
description.zh: 行进入视口：提前读它们的可用性。

description.en: As MessageActionSheet.
description.zh: 与 MessageActionSheet 相同。

description.en: The host's entries for this message, in both menus (a report action only on someone else's message; Vue's MessageMenuExtension.available).
description.zh: 宿主按这条消息给出的条目，两处共用（例如「举报」只出现在别人的消息上；对应 Vue MessageMenuExtension 的 available）。

description.en: The chosen entry, from either menu.
description.zh: 两处选中的条目。

summary.en: A call record's conversation kind.
summary.zh: 通话记录所属的会话类型。

summary.en: Where a recorded call is.
summary.zh: 通话记录对应通话所处的阶段。

summary.en: Why an ended call ended (spec/call-record-vectors.json rules.status).
summary.zh: 已结束通话的结束原因（spec/call-record-vectors.json rules.status）。

summary.en: Presentation-only summary of one person for console surfaces: no internal ID, contact data or runtime lookup.
summary.zh: 控制台界面用的单个用户展示摘要：不含内部 ID、联系方式或运行时查询。

description.en: Nickname, shown in full.
description.zh: 昵称，完整显示。

description.en: One account name (a username or one configured sign-in account), never the internal user id.
description.zh: 一个账号（用户名或一个已配置的登录账号），绝不是内部用户 id。

description.en: Avatar image; a failed load keeps the initial avatar.
description.zh: 头像图片；加载失败时保留首字头像。

description.en: Lookup state; absent means ready.
description.zh: 查询状态；缺省为 ready。

summary.en: User or group avatar — image, initials fallback, optional presence dot.
summary.zh: 用户 / 群组头像 —— 图片、首字母兜底、可选在线状态点。

dataSource.en: identity fields (displayName, avatarUrl, presence) supplied by the host
dataSource.zh: 由宿主传入身份字段（displayName、avatarUrl、presence）

description.en: Stable id, used to derive the fallback color when no image loads.
description.zh: 稳定 id，无图片时据此派生兜底底色。

description.en: Name to render; its initials become the fallback.
description.zh: 展示名；其首字母作为兜底。

description.en: Image URL; on load failure it falls back to initials.
description.zh: 头像图 URL；加载失败回退到首字母。

description.en: Diameter in px.
description.zh: 直径（px）。

description.en: Presence ring/dot; omit to hide.
description.zh: 在线状态圈点；不传则隐藏。

description.en: Alias of userId (FlareIdentity shape).
description.zh: userId 的别名（FlareIdentity 形状）。

description.en: Alias of displayName (FlareIdentity shape).
description.zh: displayName 的别名（FlareIdentity 形状）。

description.en: Opens what the avatar stands for; the avatar then reports as a button named by displayName, with a 44pt target however small it is drawn.
description.zh: 打开头像代表的对象；此时头像是以 displayName 命名的按钮，无论画多小都有 44pt 触控区。

notes.en: No click callback on any platform (no Vue emits; no onTap in Flutter/iOS/Compose) — hosts wrap it for interaction.
notes.zh: 四端都不带点击事件(Vue 无 emits;Flutter/iOS/Compose 无 onTap),交互由宿主包裹。

keyboardBehavior: Not focusable while it only shows a person; with a tap handler it is a button reached by Tab
Enter and Space activate it when it is a button
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: No motion of its own; a presence change swaps the dot without animation.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Named by the person it stands for; the initials fallback is decoration and is not read. With a tap handler it reports as a button under that same name.

summary.en: Root application region composer for mobile, tablet, desktop, and wide desktop.
summary.zh: 面向手机、平板、桌面与宽桌面的应用根区域编排器。

dataSource.en: Host-owned regions and resolved responsive mode.
dataSource.zh: 宿主提供区域内容与已解析的响应模式。

description.en: Visible pane in compact mode.
description.zh: 紧凑模式下当前可见窗格。

keyboardBehavior: Tab follows visual order: navigation, then the visible panes
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Pane mode changes are immediate: the layout swaps panes without motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Expose navigation, primary, content and detail as separate regions; in one-pane mode only the visible pane is exposed.

slotReasons.command: SwiftUI and Compose hosts layer a command palette over the shell with .overlay / a Box, which is the platform way to put one view above another; both kits ship CommandPaletteView / CommandPalette for the palette itself. A slot inside AppLayout would be a second way to do the same thing with no extra reach, because a palette is centred over the whole window, not over one pane.

summary.en: One navigation model rendered as a bottom bar, rail, or sidebar.
summary.zh: 将同一导航模型渲染为底栏、导航轨或侧栏。

dataSource.en: Host-owned navigation groups, active destination, and badges.
dataSource.zh: 宿主提供导航分组、当前目的地与角标。

description.en: Grouped navigation destinations.
description.zh: 分组后的导航目的地。

description.en: Selected destination id.
description.zh: 当前选中的目的地 ID。

description.en: Mode used to resolve presentation.
description.zh: 用于解析呈现形态的模式。

notes.en: Vue only: an item with `href` is a real link (`<a>`), so a web console keeps open-in-new-tab — Cmd / Ctrl / Shift click or the middle button is the browser's and reports nothing, while a plain click is prevented and reports `navigate` for the host's router. A disabled item stays a disabled button, and an href that `safeNavigationHref` refuses (anything but a same-origin path, a hash route, a query or an explicit http/https URL) draws a button too. Native items have no URL.
notes.zh: 仅 Vue：带 `href` 的导航项是真正的链接（`<a>`），Web 控制台因此保留「在新标签页打开」—— Cmd / Ctrl / Shift 点击或中键交给浏览器、不上报；普通点击被拦下并上报 `navigate`，由宿主路由。禁用的导航项仍是禁用的按钮；`safeNavigationHref` 拒绝的 href（同源路径、`#…`、`?…` 与显式 http/https 之外的一切）同样画成按钮。原生端导航项没有 URL。

keyboardBehavior: Arrow keys move within the current navigation axis
Home and End move to boundaries
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Selection changes without non-essential motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Expose destination labels, selected state, disabled state, and badge meaning.

summary.en: Safe-area mobile shell with content, bottom navigation, and overlay hosts.
summary.zh: 包含内容、底部导航与浮层宿主的安全区移动应用外壳。

dataSource.en: Host-owned active navigation id and region content.
dataSource.zh: 宿主提供当前导航 ID 与各区域内容。

description.en: Selected mobile destination.
description.zh: 当前选中的移动端目的地。

keyboardBehavior: Tab follows visual order
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Pane and destination changes remain immediate when reduced motion is enabled.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Expose content before the persistent navigation landmark.

summary.en: Desktop application shell with adaptive navigation and pane regions.
summary.zh: 包含自适应导航与多窗格区域的桌面应用外壳。

dataSource.en: Host-owned active destination, panes, overlays, and commands.
dataSource.zh: 宿主提供当前目的地、窗格、浮层与命令。

description.en: Selected desktop destination.
description.zh: 当前选中的桌面目的地。

description.en: Desktop or wide-desktop mode.
description.zh: 桌面或宽桌面模式。

description.en: Pane composition requested by the host; the layout still collapses below its breakpoints.
description.zh: 宿主请求的窗格组合；低于断点时布局仍会折叠。

description.en: How the detail pane is presented.
description.zh: 详情窗格的呈现方式。

description.en: Whether a detail pane is composed.
description.zh: 是否组合了详情窗格。

description.en: Primary pane width in px.
description.zh: primary 窗格宽度（px）。

description.en: Detail pane width in px.
description.zh: detail 窗格宽度（px）。

description.en: Accessible name of the shell.
description.zh: 外壳的可达性名称。

keyboardBehavior: Tab follows visual order
Host commands preserve focus context
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Pane visibility changes without non-essential motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Expose navigation and each visible pane as separate landmarks.

notes.en: Desktop keyboard commands (Escape → closeOverlay, ⌘/Ctrl+K → openCommandPalette, ⌘/Ctrl+F → openSearch, ⌘/Ctrl+N → newConversation, ⌘/Ctrl+Shift+D → toggleDetails, ⌘/Ctrl+, → openSettings, Alt+/ → moreActions) are emitted as one `command` event; the host owns what each command does. This shell absorbed the former DesktopWorkbench pattern in 2.0.0-rc.1.
notes.zh: 桌面键盘命令（Escape → closeOverlay，⌘/Ctrl+K → openCommandPalette，⌘/Ctrl+F → openSearch，⌘/Ctrl+N → newConversation，⌘/Ctrl+Shift+D → toggleDetails，⌘/Ctrl+, → openSettings，Alt+/ → moreActions）统一以 `command` 事件发出，命令的语义由宿主决定。2.0.0-rc.1 起本组件吸收了原 DesktopWorkbench 模式。

summary.en: State-aware conversation list composition with search, filters, pinned, archived, and pagination regions.
summary.zh: 统一搜索、筛选、置顶、归档、分页与状态呈现的会话列表容器。

dataSource.en: Host-owned list state and list content.
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有列表状态与列表内容。

description.en: Loading, ready, empty, error, or offline state.
description.zh: 加载、就绪、空、错误或离线状态。

description.en: Pull the ready list down to ask the host for fresh data; without it the list does not take the gesture. Flutter only: the other kits leave refreshing to the host surface.
description.zh: 下拉就绪列表向宿主要新数据；不传则不接这个手势。仅 Flutter：其他端的刷新仍由宿主页面决定。

description.en: The container's own words for an empty list; a state's own emptyTitle overrides it.
description.zh: 列表为空时容器自己的说法；状态里的 emptyTitle 覆盖它。

keyboardBehavior: Tab reaches recovery and pagination actions
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Loading and state replacement do not animate when reduced motion is enabled.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Announce loading, failure, offline, empty, and pagination progress states.

summary.en: State-aware friend directory composition with search and request regions.
summary.zh: 统一搜索、好友请求与状态呈现的好友目录容器。

dataSource.en: Host-owned friend list state and content.
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有好友列表状态与内容。

description.en: Directory loading and recovery state.
description.zh: 目录加载与恢复状态。

description.en: Label of the retry action shown with an error or offline state.
description.zh: 错误或离线状态下重试操作的文案。

description.en: Pull the ready list down to ask the host for fresh data; without it the list does not take the gesture. Flutter only: the other kits leave refreshing to the host surface.
description.zh: 下拉就绪列表向宿主要新数据；不传则不接这个手势。仅 Flutter：其他端的刷新仍由宿主页面决定。

description.en: The container's own words for an empty list; a state's own emptyTitle overrides it.
description.zh: 列表为空时容器自己的说法；状态里的 emptyTitle 覆盖它。

keyboardBehavior: Tab reaches recovery and list actions
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: State replacement remains immediate under reduced motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Announce directory state and preserve semantic grouping for requests and contacts.

summary.en: Adaptive workspace frame: primary, content and detail panes with shared loading, empty, error and offline rendering.
summary.zh: 自适应工作区框架：primary / content / detail 三窗格，统一渲染 loading、empty、error、offline 状态。

dataSource.en: Host-owned pane content and workspace state (contacts, groups, search, media, calls, settings, saved messages are all compositions of this one frame).
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有各窗格内容与工作区状态；通讯录、群组、搜索、媒体、通话、设置、收藏都是同一框架的组合。

description.en: Per-pane view state, active pane and optional banner.
description.zh: 各窗格视图状态、当前窗格与可选横幅。

description.en: Whether a detail pane is composed.
description.zh: 是否组合了详情窗格。

description.en: Accessible name of the workspace region.
description.zh: 工作区区域的可达性名称。

description.en: Pane shown when the frame collapses to a single column.
description.zh: 折叠为单列时显示的窗格。

description.en: Primary pane width in px.
description.zh: primary 窗格宽度（px）。

description.en: Detail pane width in px.
description.zh: detail 窗格宽度（px）。

keyboardBehavior: Focus follows the active pane without being reset
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Pane changes preserve state without non-essential motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Expose primary, content, detail, and banner regions independently.

summary.en: Top-level host-neutral IM application assembler.
summary.zh: 顶层、宿主中立的 IM 应用装配器。

dataSource.en: Host configuration, capability set, navigation model, and composed workspaces.
dataSource.zh: 宿主配置、能力集、导航模型与已组合工作区。

description.en: Feature, capability, locale, and navigation configuration.
description.zh: 功能、能力、语言与导航配置。

description.en: Selected application destination.
description.zh: 当前选中的应用目的地。

keyboardBehavior: Tab order follows application regions
Host navigation intents preserve focus context
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Workspace and navigation changes preserve all information without motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Expose one application context with distinct navigation, workspace, overlay, and command landmarks.

slotReasons.command: Same as AppLayout.command: the palette exists on both kits and the host puts it over the shell the platform way.
slotReasons.overlay: An app-wide layer above everything. SwiftUI (.overlay / .fullScreenCover) and Compose (Box, Dialog) already give a host that, over the whole window, which is the only place an app-wide overlay belongs.

summary.en: Lifecycle projection — pending/sending progress, sent check, compact delivered/read double-check, and retryable failure.
summary.zh: 生命周期视觉投影 —— 等待/发送进度、已发送单勾、已送达/已读紧凑双勾与可重试失败。

dataSource.en: message.status from the timeline view (optimistic, reconciled by send-ack)
dataSource.zh: 取时间线视图的 message.status（乐观显示，由 send-ack 校正）

description.en: The SDK's receipt status (MessageReceiptView.status). There is no delivered state (spec/message-receipt-vectors.json).
description.zh: SDK 给出的回执状态（MessageReceiptView.status）。没有「已送达」（spec/message-receipt-vectors.json）。

description.en: Orthogonal message lifecycle projection. When present it determines the rendered receipt state.
description.zh: 正交消息生命周期投影；提供时由它决定显示的回执状态。

description.en: Both variants preserve the same icon semantics; compact uses the smaller intrinsic size.
description.zh: 两种变体保持相同图标语义；compact 使用更小的固有尺寸。

accessibility.role: status; button only for retryable failure
keyboardBehavior: Tab focuses control
Enter or Space activates
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Remove non-essential motion; preserve state change with static content or immediate transition.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Expose localized name, role, value/state, availability, and progress. Decorative imagery is hidden.

summary.en: Stable metadata row composing timestamp, edited and ephemeral labels, delivery status, and retry.
summary.zh: 稳定的消息元数据行，组合时间、编辑/临时状态、送达状态与重试入口。

dataSource.en: Preformatted message time plus the orthogonal message lifecycle projection.
dataSource.zh: 预格式化消息时间与正交消息生命周期投影。

description.en: Preformatted message timestamp.
description.zh: 预格式化的消息时间。

description.en: Shows the localized edited marker.
description.zh: 显示本地化的已编辑标记。

description.en: Outgoing visual receipt; omit for incoming messages.
description.zh: 发出消息的视觉回执；收到的消息应省略。

description.en: Orthogonal lifecycle projection, preferred over individual state flags.
description.zh: 正交生命周期投影，优先于单独状态标记。

description.en: Fallback ephemeral state when lifecycle is absent.
description.zh: 未提供生命周期时使用的临时消息状态。

description.en: Metadata spacing density; semantic order and icon geometry stay fixed.
description.zh: 元数据间距密度；语义顺序和图标几何保持不变。

description.en: Where the meta sits (spec/message-meta-placement-vectors.json): inline, bubbleFooter, below or none. below uses the default palette at the trailing edge and turns a failure into the text key messageSendFailedRetry.
description.zh: 元信息的位置（spec/message-meta-placement-vectors.json）：inline、bubbleFooter、below 或 none。below 用默认色板、靠尾侧，失败时显示文字键「发送失败，重试」。

description.en: The SDK's group read summary {readCount, unreadCount, total} for the viewer's own message; with status sent or read it replaces the check glyph with "N unread" / "Read by all" (spec/message-receipt-vectors.json).
description.zh: SDK 给出的群已读摘要 {readCount, unreadCount, total}（仅本人消息）；状态为 sent 或 read 时以「N 人未读 / 全部已读」替代勾形（spec/message-receipt-vectors.json）。

accessibility.role: text group; nested retry button when available
keyboardBehavior: Passive metadata does not enter focus order
Enter or Space activates retry
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Delegates progress motion to MessageStatus and preserves fixed geometry.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Read timestamp and localized state names in visual order; decorative glyphs are hidden.

summary.en: The inbox — virtualised rows of conversations (avatar, title, preview, unread, timestamp).
summary.zh: 会话收件箱 —— 虚拟化的会话行（头像、标题、预览、未读、时间）。

dataSource.en: a host-owned conversation array; update its order and unread state when your data source changes
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有的会话数组；数据源变化时更新顺序与未读状态

description.en: Ordered conversation rows from the view.
description.zh: 视图给出的有序会话行。

description.en: Currently open conversation, highlighted in the list.
description.zh: 当前打开的会话，在列表中高亮。

description.en: Shows a skeleton/spinner while the first page loads.
description.zh: 首屏加载时显示骨架 / 转圈。

description.en: Vue-only item threshold that enables DOM windowing.
description.zh: Vue 长列表窗口化参数：virtualizeAbove。

description.en: Vue-only logical row estimate used to preserve scroll extent.
description.zh: Vue 长列表窗口化参数：estimatedRowHeight。

description.en: Vue-only rows rendered beyond the visible window.
description.zh: Vue 长列表窗口化参数：overscan。

description.en: Conversation actions the host implements; default rows offer a menu with exactly these, and no menu without it.
description.zh: 宿主实现的会话操作；默认行只提供这些操作的菜单，不传则没有菜单。

description.en: Batch selection: default rows become checkboxes and emit toggleSelect.
description.zh: 批量选择：默认行变成复选框并抛出 toggleSelect。

description.en: Selected conversation ids in batch selection.
description.zh: 批量选择中已选的会话 id。

notes.en: Default rows use the canonical ConversationRow. Pinned rows precede normal rows, preserving order within each group. Vue emits select/action/toggleSelect; rows present their own menu from `capabilities` (dropdown at the pointer, action sheet on phones), so hosts never open a second one. Its item slot receives item, active and selected. Native platforms expose onSelect/onLongPress and the host presents ConversationActionSheet; Flutter also exposes onLoadMore.
notes.zh: 默认行使用 canonical ConversationRow；置顶优先，组内保持宿主顺序。Vue 提供 select/action/toggleSelect；行根据 `capabilities` 自己呈现菜单（指针处下拉，手机上为操作面板），宿主不再另开菜单。item 插槽接收 item、active、selected。原生端提供 onSelect/onLongPress，由宿主呈现 ConversationActionSheet，Flutter 另有 onLoadMore。

keyboardBehavior: Tab visits interactive descendants in visual order
Escape closes the active contextual layer
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Remove non-essential motion; preserve state change with static content or immediate transition.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Expose a named group and meaningful descendant roles, values, states, availability, and progress. Decorative imagery is hidden.

notes.en: Title weight has two tiers: medium by default, bold only when the row needs attention — unread and not quiet (muted without a mention). description.zh: 渲染多选勾选框。

description.en: Which long-press actions are enabled for this message. `availability(message)` is the host's snapshot of the core's MessageActionAvailability (what the native MessageMenuSource.availability reads; null while it has none): a false flag switches that action off, nothing switches one on — a plugin card the core will not forward has no forward.
description.zh: 该消息长按可用的操作集合。`availability(message)` 是宿主手里核心 MessageActionAvailability 的快照（即原生 MessageMenuSource.availability 读的那份；没有时为 null）：为 false 的标志关掉对应动作，不会打开任何动作——核心不允许转发的插件卡没有「转发」。

description.en: Host actions (report, translate, ...) listed in the message menu: ordinary ones before delete, destructive ones after it; `available` filters them per message. Selecting one emits action.
description.zh: 列在消息菜单里的宿主操作（举报、翻译等）：普通操作在删除前，危险操作在删除后；`available` 按消息过滤。选择后抛出 action。

description.en: Where this message's picture, video or file stands on the device: idle / failed show a download key, downloading shows progress, saved (Vue `openFolder`, or `downloaded` right after the save; native `done`) turns the key into a folder that emits `mediaReveal` (Vue `mediaAction(…, "openFolder")`). A host that finds the saved file gone passes idle again. Received or sent, the time row sits on the bubble's trailing edge.
description.zh: 这条消息的图片 / 视频 / 文件在本机的状态：idle / failed 显示下载键，downloading 显示进度，已保存（Vue `openFolder`，或刚下完的 `downloaded`；原生 `done`）时键变成文件夹，点击发 `mediaReveal`（Vue 为 `mediaAction(…, "openFolder")`）。宿主发现保存的文件已不在就传回 idle。收发两侧的时间行都贴在气泡尾边（右侧）。

notes.en: Optimistic: semantic status comes from host-owned lifecycle state, never a network wait. A recalled message (lifecycle mutation recalled) renders a notice in place of its content on every platform, with no status, avatar, actions or selection. Reactions render under the bubble; a pill toggles the viewer's reaction through react only when the host handles it, and never in multi-select mode. A reply renders its quote (sender and one-line summary) at the top of the bubble on every platform; the quote is a button that raises locateMessage only when the host handles it and multi-select is off, and a quoting message keeps its bubble chrome. toggle-select exists only on Vue and Flutter (onToggleSelect); iOS and Compose do not offer it yet. forward / multiSelect / recall are Vue-only on the bubble: native bubbles raise onLongPress and the host opens MessageActionSheet, whose onAction dispatches those. Vue host actions (`actions`) join the menu and raise action; copy reports whether the clipboard took the text. Surface and meta (docs/design/message-surface-and-meta.md): the surface comes from spec/message-surface-vectors.json and the time / receipt placement from spec/message-meta-placement-vectors.json — inline after a text's last line, bubbleFooter inside other bubbles, below (spacing.xs, trailing edge, default palette) for bareMedia and card, none for centered rows; nothing is drawn over media or cards. A failed outgoing card or picture shows the text key "Failed to send. Retry" below it, a failed bubble is the failure surface (spec/message-surface-vectors.json palette: message.failed.background, its text in message.failed.foreground, a 1px message.failed.border edge, the only edge a bubble has) and its glyph is the retry key; both hit areas are at least layout.touchTarget. The receipt is the SDK's MessageReceiptView (spec/message-receipt-vectors.json): five states with no delivered glyph, and in groups the viewer's own messages show "N unread" / "Read by all" from message.readSummary, a key that emits readReceiptOpen(messageId) when the host listens. In multi-select the content is inert and a tap anywhere on the row toggles its selection. The row's accessible name is sender, content summary, time and status / read summary in that order. Desktop context menu (C5): one menu model on every kit, opened where the pointer is. Vue draws it itself — on pointer devices (`useMessageMenuInteraction` profile `enableContextMenu`) a right click on a message opens MessageMenu's dropdown at the pointer and each entry raises its own event (reply, forward, recall, …), so Vue has no contextMenu event. Flutter (macOS, Windows, Linux, web) and SwiftUI (macOS, an iPad with a pointer) take MessageList's `menu` (FlareMessageMenuSource) and draw the pointer menu where the pointer is from the entries the long-press sheet draws; Flutter's MessageBubble still raises contextMenu(message, position) for a host that draws a bubble on its own. Compose has none yet.
notes.zh: 乐观：语义状态来自宿主持有的生命周期，绝不等待网络。已撤回消息（生命周期 mutation 为 recalled）在各端都以提示行替代原内容，不显示状态、头像、操作与选择。表情回应显示在气泡下方；只有宿主处理 react 时，点击回应才切换当前用户的回应，多选模式下不切换。回复消息在各端气泡顶部显示引用（发送者与一行摘要）；只有宿主处理 locateMessage 且不在多选模式时引用才是按钮，带引用的消息保留气泡外框。toggle-select 目前只有 Vue 与 Flutter(onToggleSelect),iOS/Compose 尚未提供。forward / multiSelect / recall 在气泡上是 Vue 专有:原生端气泡只抛 onLongPress,由宿主打开 MessageActionSheet 后经其 onAction 分发。Vue 宿主操作(`actions`)进入菜单并抛出 action;copy 回报剪贴板是否写入成功。表面与元信息（docs/design/message-surface-and-meta.md）：表面取自 spec/message-surface-vectors.json，时间与回执的位置取自 spec/message-meta-placement-vectors.json —— 文本跟在最后一行行尾（inline），其他气泡在气泡内右下（bubbleFooter），bareMedia 与 card 在表面下方（spacing.xs、尾侧、默认色板），centered 不显示；不在媒体或卡片上叠任何东西。发送失败的卡片或图片在下方显示「发送失败，重试」文字键，失败的气泡是失败面（spec/message-surface-vectors.json palette：message.failed.background 底、正文 message.failed.foreground、1px message.failed.border 红边，气泡唯一的描边），图标即重试键；两者命中区都不小于 layout.touchTarget。回执是 SDK 给出的 MessageReceiptView（spec/message-receipt-vectors.json）：五态，没有「已送达」图形；群聊里本人消息按 message.readSummary 显示「N 人未读 / 全部已读」，宿主监听时它是按钮，点按发出 readReceiptOpen(messageId)。多选态下内容不响应，点整行任意处切换选中。行的读屏名依次是发送者、内容摘要、时间、状态或已读摘要。桌面右键菜单（C5）：各端同一份菜单模型，在指针处打开。Vue 自己画——指针设备上（`useMessageMenuInteraction` 的 `enableContextMenu`）右键消息在指针处打开 MessageMenu 下拉，每一项各自发出事件（reply、forward、recall…），所以 Vue 没有 contextMenu 事件。Flutter（macOS、Windows、Linux、Web）与 SwiftUI（macOS、带指针的 iPad）由 MessageList 的 `menu`（FlareMessageMenuSource）在指针处画右键菜单，条目与长按面板同一份；Flutter 的 MessageBubble 仍发出 contextMenu(message, position)，给单独画气泡的宿主用。Compose 暂无。

description.en: One source for the long-press sheet and the pointer (right-click) menu: availability(message) reads the host's snapshot of the core's MessageActionAvailability, prefetch(ids) is called for rows coming on screen, hiddenActions as MessageActionSheet, extraActions(message) the host's entries for that message (MessageActionSheet's actions; a report action only on someone else's message), perform(message, actionId) for both. The kit builds both menus with the MessageActionSheet entry function; without a snapshot the pointer menu shows one disabled messageMenuLoading entry and prefetches. Replaces the SwiftUI contextMenu entries closure. Vue drives the same from menuConfig + actions.
description.zh: 长按面板与指针（右键）菜单的同一个来源：availability(message) 同步读宿主手里核心 MessageActionAvailability 的快照，prefetch(ids) 在行进入视口时调用，hiddenActions 与 MessageActionSheet 同义，extraActions(message) 按这条消息给出宿主的条目（即 MessageActionSheet 的 actions，例如「举报」只出现在别人的消息上），perform(message, actionId) 两处共用。Kit 用 MessageActionSheet 的条目函数画两处；还没有快照时右键菜单只有一条不可点的「正在读取…」并触发预读。取代 SwiftUI 的 contextMenu entries 闭包。Vue 由 menuConfig + actions 同源驱动。

notes.en: 60fps virtualised; O(visible); scroll anchoring on append/prepend. toggle-select exists only on Vue and Flutter (onToggleSelect); iOS and Compose do not offer it yet. locateMessage: every list scrolls to a loaded quoted message itself and raises onLocateMessage only for one that is not loaded; the host pages it in and then asks the list to show it — `scrollToMessage(id)`, which answers whether the list had that message. Vue exposes that method on the component instance; the three native kits take a host-held handle (`controller`, Compose `state`). Two rules the handle carries: a row answers to two ids — the one it is drawn with and the core's id for it (`serverId`) — so the host hands `scrollToMessage` exactly what `onLocateMessage` gave it and translates nothing; and the handle answers for the pass the list last drew, so the host yields one of its own builds before asking. A quote always names the quoted message by the core's id for it, which is the id every other client knows it by. The trip itself is the kit's too: `flareLocateMessage` / `FlareLocate.run` asks the list, reads a page of older history through the host's callback, lets the list draw and asks again — 24 pages at most, then six more asks — and ends as shown, notInHistory or cancelled (`spec/locate-orchestration-vectors.json`). A host supplies how a page is read and the words for a miss, not the loop. The row a jump lands on is then marked for one window so the reader can see which row it was: `spec/locate-highlight-vectors.json` holds the window (1600 ms) and the three stops of the ring the four kits draw behind the bubble, one row marked at a time, and a second jump moves the mark rather than adding one. Reduce Motion holds the ring still instead of removing it — a reader who asked for less motion still has to be told where the jump landed. The mark is the sighted half of the answer; the other half is spoken. When a jump lands, the list announces which row it reached — the sender and the same one line a reply strip would show (`flareLocatedAnnouncement`) — through each platform's own announcement channel. Where a platform can move the reading cursor without changing how everyone else navigates, the jump takes the reader there too — Vue through the timeline's roving tabindex, SwiftUI through `@AccessibilityFocusState`; Flutter and Compose announce only, because moving the cursor there would mean making every row focusable. The return is each platform's idiom for the same answer: sync on Flutter and SwiftUI, `Promise<boolean>` on Vue, `suspend` on Compose. swipeReply: dragging a row towards the trailing edge starts a reply to it (leading edge under RTL). One rule on the three native kits, shared as `spec/swipe-reply-vectors.json`: only that direction counts, the list's own vertical scrolling wins any drag whose horizontal travel is under 1.25 times its vertical travel, the row follows the finger to 56 and then resists at 0.35 and stops at 72, and 56 is where the gesture arms — the reply affordance reaches full strength exactly there, so the reader knows before letting go, and dragging back below it cancels. A notice, a recalled message and multi-select mode carry no swipe. The gesture is never the only way to reply: the message menu raises the same intent, and the host builds the same quote for both. Vue has no swipe — the web timeline is pointer-first and a horizontal touch drag there fights the list's own scrolling. Vue: `unreadFromId` draws UnreadDivider (which also starts a new sender run), and the header, footer, empty and unread-divider slots keep typing rows and states inside the timeline. Grouping, row presentation and date pills follow spec/message-grouping-vectors.json: a run is one sender within 5 minutes, broken by centered rows (system, recall, delete), a switch between card and the other surfaces, date pills and the unread divider; only bubbles draw a tail; date pills mark local days only (today / yesterday / date). Desktop context menu (C5): one menu model on every kit, opened where the pointer is. Vue draws it itself — on pointer devices (`useMessageMenuInteraction` profile `enableContextMenu`) a right click on a message opens MessageMenu's dropdown at the pointer and each entry raises its own event (reply, forward, recall, …), so Vue has no contextMenu event. Flutter (macOS, Windows, Linux, web) and SwiftUI (macOS, an iPad with a pointer) take MessageList's `menu` (FlareMessageMenuSource) and draw the pointer menu where the pointer is from the entries the long-press sheet draws; Flutter's MessageBubble still raises contextMenu(message, position) for a host that draws a bubble on its own. Compose has none yet.
notes.zh: 60fps 虚拟化；O(visible)；追加 / 前插时锚定滚动位。toggle-select 目前只有 Vue 与 Flutter(onToggleSelect),iOS/Compose 尚未提供。locateMessage:四端列表都自己滚到已加载的被引用消息,只有未加载时才抛 onLocateMessage;宿主翻到那条之后请列表把它显示出来——`scrollToMessage(id)`,按列表画出来的行 id 回答有没有这条。Vue 把这个方法暴露在组件实例上,三个原生 kit 用宿主持有的句柄(`controller`,Compose 为 `state`)。两条规则:一行认两个 id——它被画出来时用的那个,和核心给它的那个(`serverId`),所以宿主把 `onLocateMessage` 给的 id 原样传回 `scrollToMessage`,不做任何换算;句柄按列表最近画的那一遍回答,所以宿主要先让自己的一次构建过去再问。引用永远用核心 id 指向被引用消息——那是别的客户端唯一认得的 id。这趟路本身也归 kit:`flareLocateMessage` / `FlareLocate.run` 先问列表,再经宿主回调翻一页历史,让列表画一遍再问——最多 24 页,之后再问六次——结局是 shown / notInHistory / cancelled(`spec/locate-orchestration-vectors.json`)。宿主提供「怎么翻一页」和「找不到时说什么」,不提供循环。落点那一行随后会被标记一个窗口,让读者看见跳到的是哪一条:`spec/locate-highlight-vectors.json` 规定窗口(1600 ms)与四端在气泡后面画的那一圈的三个停靠点;同一时刻只标记一行,再跳一次是把标记挪过去,不是多亮一行。Reduce Motion 下这一圈静止而不是消失——要求减少动效的读者同样需要知道跳到了哪里。标记是这个答案看得见的那一半,另一半是说出来的:落地时列表会播报跳到了哪一行——发送者,加上回复条会显示的那一句摘要(`flareLocatedAnnouncement`),各端走自己的播报通道。在能够「移动读屏光标又不改变其他人导航方式」的平台上,跳转还会把读者带过去——Vue 借时间线已有的 roving tabindex,SwiftUI 用 `@AccessibilityFocusState`;Flutter 与 Compose 只播报,因为在那两端移动光标意味着把每一行都变成可聚焦的。返回值按各端习惯:Flutter 与 SwiftUI 同步,Vue 是 Promise,Compose 是挂起函数。swipeReply:把一行往尾边方向拖动开始回复它(RTL 下是前边)。三个原生 kit 同一条规则,共享表是 `spec/swipe-reply-vectors.json`:只认这一个方向;横向位移不足竖向 1.25 倍时让位给列表自己的滚动;行跟手到 56,之后按 0.35 阻尼、最多 72;56 是上膛点——回复图标正好在这里到达满强度,所以松手前读者就知道会触发,拖回去则取消。系统提示行、已撤回消息、多选模式都没有侧滑。侧滑永远不是唯一的回复入口:消息菜单抛的是同一个意图,宿主为两者构造同一条引用。Vue 没有侧滑——网页时间线以指针为先,横向触摸拖拽会和列表自身的滚动打架。Vue:`unreadFromId` 画出 UnreadDivider(同时开启新的发送者分组),header、footer、empty、unread-divider 插槽让输入中行与各状态留在时间线里。分组、行呈现和日期胶囊按 spec/message-grouping-vectors.json：同一发送者 5 分钟内为一组，居中行（系统、撤回、删除）、卡片与其他表面之间的切换、日期胶囊和未读分隔线都会断开；只有气泡画尾角；日期胶囊只标本地自然日（今天 / 昨天 / 日期）。桌面右键菜单（C5）：各端同一份菜单模型，在指针处打开。Vue 自己画——指针设备上（`useMessageMenuInteraction` 的 `enableContextMenu`）右键消息在指针处打开 MessageMenu 下拉，每一项各自发出事件（reply、forward、recall…），所以 Vue 没有 contextMenu 事件。Flutter（macOS、Windows、Linux、Web）与 SwiftUI（macOS、带指针的 iPad）由 MessageList 的 `menu`（FlareMessageMenuSource）在指针处画右键菜单，条目与长按面板同一份；Flutter 的 MessageBubble 仍发出 contextMenu(message, position)，给单独画气泡的宿主用。Compose 暂无。

notes.en: Resolution order is preset → host additions/overrides → capability/removal/visibility filtering → stable ordering. Search, audio call, video call, add member, share, and details are host intents only; the kit never imports SDK business types. Vue slots and Flutter builders / Compose lambdas / SwiftUI ViewBuilders target identity, action icons, action regions, and trailing content without replacing the whole header. FlareChatHeader / ChatHeaderView remain compatibility wrappers. The identity `action` makes the avatar, title and subtitle one button (named by the title and the action); an action's `pressed` makes it a toggle (selected look, pressed state for assistive technology).
notes.zh: 解析顺序为预设 → 宿主新增/覆盖 → 能力/移除/可见性过滤 → 稳定排序。搜索、音频通话、视频通话、添加成员、分享和详情仅是宿主意图；组件库不导入 SDK 业务类型。Vue 插槽及 Flutter builder / Compose lambda / SwiftUI ViewBuilder 对身份、动作图标、动作区域和尾部内容进行定向扩展，无需整块替换头部。FlareChatHeader / ChatHeaderView 保留为兼容包装。 身份区的 `action` 让头像、标题与副标题成为一个按钮（以标题和动作命名）；动作的 `pressed` 使其成为开关（选中外观，辅助技术可读的按下状态）。

notes.en: Built-in types live in `contentTypes.registered`; register new ones for product content. Each type is also a standalone component: [TextMessage](/en/components/text-message) · [ImageMessage](/en/components/image-message) · [VideoMessage](/en/components/video-message) · [VoiceMessage](/en/components/voice-message) · [FileMessage](/en/components/file-message) · [LocationMessage](/en/components/location-message) · [ContactMessage](/en/components/contact-message) · [LinkCardMessage](/en/components/link-card-message) · [VoteMessage](/en/components/vote-message) · [TaskMessage](/en/components/task-message) · [StickerMessage](/en/components/sticker-message) · [EmojiMessage](/en/components/emoji-message) · [SystemMessage](/en/components/system-message). Custom renderers: register one as `bare` (Vue: a `{ component, bare: true }` entry; Flutter / Compose: `FlareContentScope` `bareTypes` or `FlareContentRegistry.register(type, builder, bare: true)`; SwiftUI: `flareContentRenderers(_:bare:)`) and the timeline draws it the way it draws a lone picture — no bubble surface or padding — keeping avatar, name, time, selection and menu; a quote or a recall still gets the bubble. Renderers receive `messageId` (the server id, else the client id) and `conversationId` (optional; the message list supplies its own).
notes.zh: 内建类型见 `contentTypes.registered`，产品内容可注册新类型。每种类型也都是独立组件：[TextMessage](/components/text-message) · [ImageMessage](/components/image-message) · [VideoMessage](/components/video-message) · [VoiceMessage](/components/voice-message) · [FileMessage](/components/file-message) · [LocationMessage](/components/location-message) · [ContactMessage](/components/contact-message) · [LinkCardMessage](/components/link-card-message) · [VoteMessage](/components/vote-message) · [TaskMessage](/components/task-message) · [StickerMessage](/components/sticker-message) · [EmojiMessage](/components/emoji-message) · [SystemMessage](/components/system-message)。 自定义渲染器：注册时可标 `bare`（Vue 注册值为 `{ component, bare: true }`；Flutter/Compose 为 `FlareContentScope` 的 `bareTypes` 或 `FlareContentRegistry.register(type, builder, bare: true)`；SwiftUI 为 `flareContentRenderers(_:bare:)`），消息列表就像渲染单图那样去掉气泡底和内边距，保留头像、昵称、时间、多选和长按菜单；引用或撤回时仍画气泡。渲染器拿到 `messageId`（服务端 ID，没有时用 clientMsgId）和 `conversationId`（可空，消息列表会补上自己的会话）。

description.en: Host download lifecycle; drives the trailing key and the meta line. description.en: The tenant's map service, which decides the default web link (osm or amap).
description.zh: 租户配置的地图服务，决定默认的网页地图链接（osm 或 amap）。

notes.en: Without a host `open` handler the card opens its default link from spec/location-vectors.json: Vue the `web` link by provider (OpenStreetMap marker or uri.amap.com marker, WGS-84), SwiftUI the `apple` link (maps.apple.com), Compose the `geo:` URI; Flutter has no URL launcher, so MessageContentView hands the platform's link (flutterTargets) to `onOpenLink`. The map area is 264 × 132 logical px: request the snapshot at twice that. The snapshot carries its own centre marker (the geo proxy draws it); the kit draws its pin only on the texture. `mapImage` is gone (breaking): it is `snapshotUrl`. A coordinate of exactly 0, 0 from the wire is treated as no coordinate by the timeline adapters. With provider osm the static map carries OpenStreetMap's credit (ODbL): locationOsmAttribution ("© OpenStreetMap contributors", the same in every language) as a small line in the bottom-right corner of the picture, secondary text on a translucent ground, clear of the centre marker; not on the drawn texture, and never for amap. A host that opens the place itself (a tapped card under the tenant's map service) takes the web map from the kit instead of rebuilding the rule: `flareLocationWebMapUrl` on all four — Vue `flareLocationWebMapUrl(location, provider?)` (./contracts), Flutter `flareLocationWebMapUrl(content, provider:)`, SwiftUI `flareLocationWebMapUrl(_:provider:)`, Compose `flareLocationWebMapUrl(location, provider)`. The provider argument wins over the content's, which is osm when it names none; the answer is null without a coordinate — one of the pair missing, out of range, or the wire's 0, 0 (spec/location-vectors.json webMapUrl). A `chat.location` config value becomes a provider through `flareLocationProviderFrom(value)` on all four: amap (trimmed, any case) is AMap, anything else OpenStreetMap (providerFrom).
notes.zh: 宿主不处理 `open` 时按 spec/location-vectors.json 打开默认链接：Vue 按服务商打开 `web` 链接（OpenStreetMap 标记或 uri.amap.com 标记，WGS-84），SwiftUI 打开 `apple` 链接（maps.apple.com），Compose 打开 `geo:` URI；Flutter 没有 URL 启动器，由 MessageContentView 按运行平台（flutterTargets）把链接交给 `onOpenLink`。地图区 264 × 132 逻辑像素，静态图按两倍请求。静态图自带中心点（地图代理绘制），Kit 只在底纹上画中心点。**破坏性**：`mapImage` 改名为 `snapshotUrl`。时间线适配层把线上的 0, 0 当作没有坐标。provider 为 osm 时，静态图上显示 OpenStreetMap 的署名（ODbL）：文案 locationOsmAttribution（「© OpenStreetMap contributors」，各语言相同），在图片右下角一行小字，secondary 文本色、半透明底，不遮中心点；手绘底图上不显示，amap 时不显示。宿主自己打开地点时（按租户地图服务打开被点的卡片），从 Kit 取网页地图地址，不再照抄规则：四端都叫 `flareLocationWebMapUrl` —— Vue `flareLocationWebMapUrl(location, provider?)`（./contracts），Flutter `flareLocationWebMapUrl(content, provider:)`，SwiftUI `flareLocationWebMapUrl(_:provider:)`，Compose `flareLocationWebMapUrl(location, provider)`。传了 provider 参数时以它为准，否则用内容里的，内容没写时为 osm；没有坐标时返回空 —— 缺一个、超出范围，或线上的 0, 0（spec/location-vectors.json 的 webMapUrl）。`chat.location` 的配置值经四端同名的 `flareLocationProviderFrom(value)` 转成服务商：amap（去掉首尾空白、不区分大小写）为高德，其他一律为 OpenStreetMap（providerFrom）。

notes.en: Responsibility boundary (2.0.0-rc.1): the composer owns the draft, panels and keyboard and composes the parts — ComposerReplyStrip, ComposerSendButton, MentionPicker and ComposerActionPanel are public, the upload strip / format strip / voice panel are private. Uploads stay host-owned (`uploadItems` in, `retryUpload` / `removeUpload` out); the mention roster is host-provided; microphone access goes through the injectable voice-recorder adapter (`provideFlareVoiceRecorder`, default = web MediaRecorder), never through the browser directly; file drops hand `File[]` to the host. Send results: Flutter `onSend` returns `FutureOr<bool>` (busy while pending, clears only on true); Compose hoists the text with `value` / `onValueChange` and iOS with the `text` binding, so hosts restore a failed send themselves. Vue offers voice only with `sendVoiceHandler` or a send-voice listener, and then shows the microphone in both toolbar presets. On Flutter, SwiftUI and Compose the "+" voice tile is the composer's own: it closes the panel and opens the recorder the voice key opens (when voice is enabled, a voice-send callback exists and the voice tool is offered), and the host gets the recording through the voice-send callback; otherwise the tile goes to the host's action callback.
notes.zh: 职责边界（2.0.0-rc.1）：Composer 只持有草稿、面板与键盘，其余组合部件——ComposerReplyStrip、ComposerSendButton、MentionPicker、ComposerActionPanel 为公开部件，上传条 / 格式条 / 语音面板为私有部件。上传由宿主持有（传入 `uploadItems`，回传 `retryUpload` / `removeUpload`）；@ 名册由宿主提供；麦克风经可注入的录音适配器（`provideFlareVoiceRecorder`，默认 Web MediaRecorder），组件不直接碰浏览器；文件拖入把 `File[]` 交给宿主。 发送结果：Flutter `onSend` 返回 `FutureOr<bool>`（等待中显示忙碌，仅为 true 时清空）；Compose 用 `value` / `onValueChange`、iOS 用 `text` 绑定托管文本，失败时由宿主恢复。Vue 只有提供 `sendVoiceHandler` 或监听 send-voice 时才提供语音，此时两种工具栏预设都显示麦克风。Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 的「+」面板 voice 项由输入框自己处理：收起面板，打开与语音键同一个录音器（需开启语音、有语音发送回调且提供 voice 工具），录音经语音发送回调交给宿主；否则交给宿主的动作回调。

description.en: Sheet model built by buildMessageContextSheetModel(message, currentUserId, menuConfig, t): showReactions, quickActions (reply / forward / recall …) and listActions (multi-select / mark / pin / copy / edit / delete).
description.zh: 由 buildMessageContextSheetModel(message, currentUserId, menuConfig, t) 生成的面板模型：showReactions、quickActions（回复 / 转发 / 撤回…）与 listActions（多选 / 标记 / 置顶 / 复制 / 编辑 / 删除）。

description.en: Render the drag handle; disable when the containing sheet supplies its own.
description.zh: 是否渲染拖拽把手；外层 sheet 已有把手时关闭。

description.en: The core's action availability for the message (the can* flags of domain::message_actions, readable from the SDK's JSON answer). The sheet derives the standard actions from it — reply / forward / recall / resend as quick actions; multiSelect / mark / pin / pinSelf / unpin / copy / preview / save / edit as the list; delete in red — with the kit's labels, icons and order, so hosts never rebuild that list.
description.zh: 核心给出的该消息操作可用性（domain::message_actions 的 can* 标志，可直接由 SDK 返回的 JSON 构造）。面板据此生成标准操作——回复 / 转发 / 撤回 / 重发为快捷操作；多选 / 标记 / 置顶 / 仅自己置顶 / 取消置顶 / 复制 / 预览 / 保存 / 编辑为列表；删除为红色——文案、图标与顺序都归 kit，宿主不再自己拼这份列表。

description.en: Ids of standard actions the host does not implement; they are left out even when the core allows them.
description.zh: 宿主未实现的标准操作 id；即使核心允许也不显示。

description.en: Host-specific entries { id, label, icon, group: primary | organize | destructive, enabled }, appended to their group after the standard actions; primary renders as the quick row, organize as the list, destructive in red at the end.
description.zh: 宿主特有的条目 { id, label, icon, group: primary | organize | destructive, enabled }，追加在对应分组的标准操作之后；primary 渲染为快捷行，organize 为列表，destructive 红色置尾。

description.en: Quick reaction emoji strip; empty hides it. Omitted, the kit's quick reactions show when availability allows reacting.
description.zh: 快捷表情条；空则不显示。不传时，可用性允许回应就显示 kit 的快捷表情。

description.en: Accessible name of the sheet; defaults to the strings table.
description.zh: 面板的无障碍名称；默认取字符串表。

description.en: Shown when there are neither actions nor reactions; defaults to the strings table.
description.zh: 没有任何操作与表情时显示；默认取字符串表。

notes.en: One typed dispatch on every platform: `action` carries the stable action id (reply / forward / recall / multiSelect / mark / pin / copy / edit / delete …) and `react` the emoji; the host performs the operation. Vue builds the model from the message's menuConfig, native hosts pass capability-filtered entries. Presentation uses the kit presenters: Vue MessageMenu (dropdown on desktop, bottom sheet on phones), Flutter `FlareMessageActionSheet.show`, iOS `flareBottomSheet`, Compose `BottomSheet`; the native presenters follow BottomSheet auto (a Modal on wide layouts, the label as a hidden title). The attachment grid is [ComposerActionPanel](/en/components/composer-action-panel), not this component.
notes.zh: 四端统一为一个类型化分发：`action` 带稳定的操作 id（reply / forward / recall / multiSelect / mark / pin / copy / edit / delete …），`react` 带表情；操作由宿主执行。Vue 由消息的 menuConfig 生成模型，原生宿主传入按能力过滤后的条目。呈现使用组件库呈现器：Vue MessageMenu（桌面下拉，手机底部面板）、Flutter `FlareMessageActionSheet.show`、iOS `flareBottomSheet`、Compose `BottomSheet`；原生呈现器遵循 BottomSheet auto（宽布局为 Modal，标签作为隐藏标题）。附件九宫格是 [ComposerActionPanel](/components/composer-action-panel)，不是本组件。

filled 是自带浅色圆角底的药丸；quiet 不画底也不画圆角，用于常驻在列表顶上的搜索——那里药丸会和下面的筛选、列表叠成三层各自为政的面。放大镜、占位文字、触达区和按下反馈在两种外观下都在。
description.en: filled draws the tinted rounded pill; quiet drops the fill and the radius, for a search that lives permanently at the top of a list. The magnifier, placeholder, hit target and press feedback are kept in both.
Entry mode for a list header: the bar looks the same but takes no text; with an activate handler it is one button named by the placeholder.
description.zh: 列表头部的入口模式：外观不变但不接收输入；有 activate 处理时整条是一个以占位文案命名的按钮。

description.zh: 输入安静多少毫秒后才发 `search`；0 表示每次按键都发。

notes.en: Text changes travel over v-model (update:modelValue), not an input event; the native equivalents are Flutter onChanged / Compose onValueChange / iOS `Binding<String>`. clear is Vue-only — native platforms clear the binding internally. `readOnly` plus `activate` (Flutter/iOS/Compose `onActivate`) is the search entry that opens a search screen: one button (tap, Enter, Space), no caret, no clear; without a handler it is display-only. Never lay a clickable overlay over an inert field instead.
notes.zh: 文本变化走 v-model(update:modelValue),不是 input 事件;原生端对应 Flutter onChanged / Compose onValueChange / iOS `Binding<String>`。clear 目前只有 Vue 有(原生端在内部清空绑定)。`readOnly` 加 `activate`(Flutter/iOS/Compose 为 `onActivate`)是打开搜索页的入口:整条是一个按钮(点按、Enter、Space),没有光标和清除;没有处理函数时只做展示。不要在不可输入的输入框上盖一层可点击遮罩。

dataSource.zh: 租户的邀请模式，加上宿主的预检状态（checking / result / error）；组件用 normalizeInviteCode() 归一化输入、用 inviteCodeFieldState() 推导状态。不发网络请求、不碰剪贴板。

description.zh: 双向绑定的码。宿主拿到的已是归一化结果：去空白、大写、O→0、I/L→1、去分隔符、截到 `length`。

description.en: Tenant invite mode. `off` renders nothing at all; `optional` labels the field as optional; `required` marks it required.
description.zh: 租户邀请模式。`off` 什么都不渲染；`optional` 标为选填；`required` 标为必填。

description.en: Deep-link value applied once, the first time the field is empty; the person can still edit or clear it afterwards.
description.zh: 深链预填值，只在字段为空时应用一次；之后仍可编辑或清空。

description.zh: 宿主对当前码的预检结果：`{ valid, inviterDisplayName? }`。宿主在码变化时清掉旧结果。

description.zh: 宿主已本地化的错误文案（INVITE_CODE_REQUIRED / INVITE_CODE_INVALID …），替代提示行；优先于 `checkResult`。

notes.en: `check` fires once, about 400 ms after typing stops, and only for a complete code (normalized length equals `length`); a partial code never reaches the network. The host performs the request and feeds `checking` and `checkResult` back. The native platforms express the model as a controlled value / binding and expose `onCheck`.

notes.en: Vue's `title` and `dismissible` turn the strip into a notice a person reads once and puts away — the console's platform announcements, by level (`tone`): a bold subject over the text and a close key (named by the kit's "Close", 48 logical px) that reports `dismiss`; the host keeps which notices were dismissed. notes.zh: Vue 的 `title` 与 `dismissible` 让这条状态条承载看过即可关闭的通知 —— 控制台按级别（`tone`）显示的平台公告：正文上方加粗的主题，以及一个关闭键（名称取组件库的「关闭」，48 逻辑像素），点击上报 `dismiss`；哪些公告已关闭由宿主记住。不传时横幅不变。它们服务于 Web 控制台；原生端横幅仍是状态条。

notes.en: Hit area: every tab keeps the pill it is drawn at (about 30 high) and takes taps over at least layout.touchTarget in both directions around it. Vue reaches past the pill with ::after and gives the scroll row the room as padding it takes back with a negative margin, so the row's layout does not grow; Flutter (opaque gesture, ConstrainedBox, Align), SwiftUI (frame minWidth/minHeight with a rectangular content shape) and Compose (sizeIn around the pill) give each tab a touch-target cell with the pill centred in it. The Vue grid and quiet rows grow to the touch target on coarse pointers instead. enabled false dims the row and disables every tab.
notes.zh: 命中区：每个标签保持画出来的胶囊（约 30 高），命中区在它周围两个方向都不小于 layout.touchTarget。Vue 用 ::after 越过胶囊，滚动行以内距给出空间、再用负外距收回，版面不变高；Flutter（opaque 手势、ConstrainedBox、Align）、SwiftUI（frame minWidth/minHeight 加矩形 contentShape）与 Compose（胶囊外 sizeIn）给每个标签一个触达区大小的格子，胶囊居中。Vue 的 grid 与 quiet 行在粗指针下改为长到触达区。enabled 为 false 时整行变淡、每个标签禁用。

notes.en: Every action appears only when the host handles it. A stranger's page gets its primary action from primaryActionLabel plus the primaryAction handler: the key leads the action row (person-add icon, primary style) and Message, when handled, follows as a secondary key; busy disables it with the rest. Host actions that are not the page's main step (report, share) stay in extraActions in the footer. primaryActionBusy locks the primary key alone while the host runs it (a spinner in place of the person-add icon, no taps, announced as in progress); the rest of the page stays usable, so a slow request does not freeze Message or the footer.

notes.en: Member intents carry the state the host should write: promoteMember(userId, admin) and muteMember(userId, muted), computed from the model when tapped, so the host never recomputes a toggle. One confirmation rule on every platform: transferring ownership is confirmed inside the component; removing a member and leaving (or dissolving) are emitted as tapped and the host confirms them with its presenter (Vue useFlareConfirm, Flutter FlareDangerConfirm.show, iOS FlareFeedback.confirm, Compose DangerConfirm), which also owns busy, error and retry for the write. Compose takes headerActions for host actions at the end of its header. The join policy is `FlareGroupJoinPolicy` (open, approval, invite); an unknown policy reads as not set and the picker opens with nothing selected, and `setJoinPolicy` carries the picked policy. The message button exists only when the host handles `openChat`.
notes.zh: 成员意图携带宿主应写入的目标状态：promoteMember(userId, admin) 与 muteMember(userId, muted)，在点击时由模型算出，宿主不再自行推算开关方向。各端同一条确认规则：转让群主在组件内确认；移除成员与退出（或解散）按点击直接发出，由宿主用自己的呈现器确认（Vue useFlareConfirm、Flutter FlareDangerConfirm.show、iOS FlareFeedback.confirm、Compose DangerConfirm），写操作的忙碌、错误与重试也由它负责。Compose 通过 headerActions 在头部末端放置宿主操作。 进群方式为 `FlareGroupJoinPolicy`（open、approval、invite）；未知时显示「未设置」，选择器打开时不选中任何项，`setJoinPolicy` 携带所选方式。只有宿主处理 `openChat` 时才有发消息按钮。

notes.en: Rules: spec/call-record-vectors.json (status, tone, action, duration), run by all four kits. Status: ringing — group "Group call ringing", caller "Waiting for answer", callee "Calling you"; ongoing — 1:1 "In call", group "Group call · N joined"; ended — completed "Duration mm:ss" (group "Group call ended · mm:ss"), cancelled "Cancelled" / "Caller cancelled", declined "Declined" / "You declined", missed "No answer" / "Missed call" (the callee's missed call takes the danger tone), busy "Busy" / "Missed (busy)", unavailable, failed; a group call that ended otherwise reads "Group call ended". Action: none while disabled; Join for a group call that has not ended when canJoin; Call back for an ended 1:1 call when canCallBack. The icon set has no outgoing / incoming variants, so the copy carries direction. The card is the message's card surface (the kit card shell, richCardWidth like every card): no bubble around it; outgoing and incoming records differ by alignment only.
notes.zh: 规则：spec/call-record-vectors.json（状态、语气、操作、时长），四端共跑。状态：振铃 —— 群聊「群通话呼叫中」，主叫「等待对方接听」，被叫「邀请你通话」；进行中 —— 单聊「通话中」，群聊「群通话进行中 · N 人」；已结束 —— 完成「通话时长 mm:ss」（群聊「群通话已结束 · 时长 mm:ss」），取消「已取消」/「对方已取消」，拒绝「对方已拒绝」/「已拒绝」，未接「对方未接听」/「未接听」（被叫的未接来电用危险色），忙线「对方忙线中」/「忙线未接听」，不可用、失败；群通话以其他原因结束时显示「群通话已结束」。操作：disabled 时无；群通话未结束且 canJoin 时「加入」；单聊已结束且 canCallBack 时「回拨」。图标集没有呼出 / 呼入变体，方向由文案表达。卡片就是消息的 card 表面（kit 卡片外壳，与其他卡片同为 richCardWidth），外面不套气泡；收发两侧只靠对齐区分。

notes.en: spec/read-receipt-vectors.json. The tab numbers are the summary counts the host passes, never list lengths. Each column pages on its own (loadMore(column), one request at a time per column). The paging state is the kit's holder, not the host's: Vue useFlareReadReceiptList(key, page), Compose rememberFlareReadReceiptListState(key, page), the same names on SwiftUI and Flutter; the host gives one loader page(column, cursor?) that names a page or answers null when the list is not offered (spec/read-receipt-list-vectors.json). The sheet takes its container's width: outside a kit overlay it draws its own card shell, at most 320 wide; inside a kit BottomSheet or Modal it draws no shell and declares its own header, and the host opens it with the sheet's fill mode so the title is not drawn twice.
notes.zh: spec/read-receipt-vectors.json。标签上的数字取宿主传的摘要人数，不取列表长度。两栏各自分页（loadMore(column)，每栏同时只请求一次）。分页状态在 Kit 的持有者里、不在宿主：Vue useFlareReadReceiptList(key, page)，Compose rememberFlareReadReceiptListState(key, page)，SwiftUI / Flutter 同名；宿主只给一个按栏取页的 page(column, cursor?)，取不到名单（不开放）时返回 null（spec/read-receipt-list-vectors.json）。宽度随容器：不在 Kit 浮层里时自画卡片外壳，最宽 320；在 Kit BottomSheet / Modal 里不画外壳并声明自带标题，宿主用面板的 fill 模式打开，标题不重复。

notes.en: Red packet v5 (docs/design/red-packet-v5-roles-and-wallet.md §1): the card shows the greeting, the kind badge (lucky, exclusive; normal has none), "For {name}" on exclusive packets and one status line — and never an amount. Status precedence (spec/red-packet-vectors.json → card): busy, statusLabel, then by state: tapToOpen ("Open"), view, claimed, finished, expired, refunded; disabled shows unavailable. Every state but busy / disabled emits open; the host routes by the personal layer's tapAction (open sheet, details, or the not-eligible notice). Fading (→ faded) applies to claimed, finished, expired and refunded: each card colour is mixed in sRGB toward colors.redPacket.fadedMixTarget by sizes.component.redPacketFadedMix (0.4), text switches to colors.redPacket.fadedInk at 4.5:1 or better; busy and disabled keep the unopened face. The leading mark is the shared 30-wide envelope glyph. The card is the message's card surface: no bubble around it.

notes.en: Draws only, never decides eligibility: the host prefetches details, maps canClaim to state, sets opening on 開 and calls claim. Scrim tap, the close control under the envelope, Escape and the platform back all emit close. Flutter paints its own scrim: lay it in a Stack or present it with FlareRedPacketOpenSheet.show. The notEligible notice and the error line use the body line height (lineHeight.normal) and stop at three lines. Keys per state in spec/red-packet-vectors.json → openSheet: 開 while ready, opening or error; the details key only for finished / expired with canViewDetails; never for notEligible (the server returns no amount or records to a non-designated viewer). refunded (PACKET_REFUNDED, or the public status refunded) says redPacket.refundedNotice / packetRefundedNotice; like expired it has no 開 and offers the details only with canViewDetails (spec/red-packet-vectors.json openSheetRefunded).

notes.en: An ordinary page, not an overlay: the host pushes it inside the kit Screen container. With back (native onBack) the page draws its own red title bar. What it draws per viewerRole and status is spec/red-packet-vectors.json → detail: the viewer's own amount large with "Saved to your wallet" when myAmountMinor is there; a headline for the eligible who came too late ("Too late, all claimed" / "This red packet has expired") and for the non-designated ("Only {name} can open this"); the summary line (totals only when the server returned them, i.e. to the sender); the claim list only when claimsListed; the sender's refund note. Amounts are formatted from minor units with currencyExponent by integer arithmetic (flareRedPacketMoney); best luck is decided by the server.
