The currency's ISO 4217 exponent from the plugin's limits (0 JPY, 2 CNY, 3 KWD): the amount field keeps at most that many decimals (none at 0) and its placeholder has that many. flareRedPacketAmountMinor(text, exponent) turns the field into minor units (spec/red-packet-vectors.json amountInputExponent, amountMinor, amountPlaceholder).
description.zh: 币种的 ISO 4217 小数位（插件 limits 给出；JPY 0、CNY 2、KWD 3）：金额框最多保留这么多位小数（0 时不收小数点），占位也按它写。flareRedPacketAmountMinor(text, exponent) 把输入换成最小单位（spec/red-packet-vectors.json amountInputExponent、amountMinor、amountPlaceholder）。
个数（双向绑定），只在群聊的 lucky / normal 显示；0 表示未填
description.en: Share count (two-way), shown only for a group's lucky / normal; 0 while empty

description.zh: 祝福语（双向绑定），占位符为默认祝福语
description.en: Greeting (two-way); the placeholder is the default greeting

description.zh: 宿主格式化的总额，大字显示，如「¥0.00」
description.en: Host-formatted total drawn large, e.g. "¥0.00"

description.zh: 宿主校验错误
description.en: Host validation error

description.zh: 创建命令进行中：锁定所有字段和按钮
description.en: Create command in flight: every field and the button are locked

description.zh: 提交按钮文案，默认「塞钱进红包」
description.en: Submit label; defaults to "Put money in"

description.zh: 原命令结果未知、等待核对：所有输入和种类切换只读，提交按钮不可点，不显示加载动画（与 busy 不同）；读屏标为只读。宿主通常在表单上方用 StatusBanner 说明原因。
description.en: The original command's outcome is unknown and awaits reconciliation: fields and the kind switch are read-only and the button is inert, without progress (unlike busy); assistive technology reads them as read-only. The host usually explains why in a StatusBanner above.

keyboardBehavior: Tab moves through the kind switch, the fields and the submit button
Enter or Space activates a kind segment and the submit button
Enter in a field does not submit (no accidental payment)
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: No motion beyond the kit button and segment transitions, which follow their own reduced-motion rules.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Each field is named by its visible label (the greeting by its own name, since its placeholder is the default greeting); the kind switch is named; the error is an alert; the total is a polite live region.

notes.zh: 组件只做格式限制（spec/red-packet-vectors.json → amountInput / countInput），上下限、余额和总额由宿主完成。哪些行显示、金额标签叫什么见 spec/red-packet-vectors.json → composer：kinds 恰为 [normal]（单聊）时不显示分段和个数，金额标签为 packetFieldAmount。专属红包的收款人由宿主用 Kit 成员选择组件填入 recipient。提交按钮复用 Kit Button，只把 primary 改为 redPacket.end；种类切换的选中项用 SegmentedControl 的 accent 着色为 redPacket.accent（浅色 #C8291F、深色 #FF7B6B）。
notes.en: The form only restricts the format (spec/red-packet-vectors.json → amountInput / countInput); ranges, balance and the total are the host's. Which rows show and what the amount is called follow spec/red-packet-vectors.json → composer: with kinds exactly [normal] (a 1:1 chat) there is no switch and no count, and the amount label is packetFieldAmount. The host fills recipient with the kit member picker for an exclusive packet. The submit button is the kit Button with primary re-tinted to redPacket.end; the selected kind is tinted through SegmentedControl accent with redPacket.accent (#C8291F light, #FF7B6B dark).

summary.zh: 支付确认 —— 底部面板：大字金额、支付方式行、确认 / 取消；余额不足时不能确认。
summary.en: Payment confirmation — bottom panel with the amount drawn large, the method row, confirm and cancel; no confirm on an insufficient balance.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入；金额、时间、名字由宿主格式化，组件不做资金计算也不请求网络
dataSource.en: passed in by you; amounts, times and names arrive formatted, the component never computes money or fetches

description.zh: 是否显示（Vue；原生用 show 或宿主呈现）
description.en: Whether the panel is shown (Vue; native uses show or host presentation)

description.zh: 支付金额（大字），如「¥5.00」
description.en: Amount to pay, drawn large, e.g. "¥5.00"

description.zh: 支付方式，如「钱包（余额 ¥12.00）」
description.en: Paying account, e.g. "Wallet (balance ¥12.00)"

description.zh: 余额不足：确认不可用并显示「余额不足」
description.en: Insufficient balance: confirm is disabled and says why

description.zh: 支付进行中：两个按钮和所有关闭方式都锁定
description.en: Payment in flight: both buttons and every way out are locked

description.zh: 确认按钮文案；宿主区分付款和资金授权，默认沿用确认支付。
description.en: Confirm label; lets the host distinguish payment from authorizing funds. Defaults to Confirm payment.

keyboardBehavior: Tab is trapped inside the panel
Enter or Space activates confirm and cancel
Escape and the platform back cancel unless busy
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: The panel appears without the slide; the scrim appears instantly.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Dialog named "Confirm payment"; the method row reads as one line; the insufficient notice is an alert; confirm is busy while paying.

notes.zh: 沙箱钱包，不做支付密码。手机形态是底部面板，其余形态交给 Modal（复用 Kit BottomSheet）。确认按钮复用 Kit Button，primary 改为 redPacket.end。
notes.en: Sandbox wallet, no payment password. A bottom sheet on the phone form factor, a centered modal elsewhere (the kit BottomSheet). Confirm is the kit Button with primary re-tinted to redPacket.end.

summary.en: Generic plugin card — the core SDK's resolved view drawn as a kit business card: blocks (text, fields, choices, entries, people, status, progress, time, divider, note; rows on Vue admin pages), then the action keys.
summary.zh: 通用插件卡片 —— 把核心 SDK 解析好的视图画成 Kit 业务卡片：展示块（文本、键值、选项、条目、人员、状态、进度、时间、分隔、提示；Vue 管理页另有 rows），再是底部动作。

dataSource.en: the core SDK's plugin present / detail result; user names from the host's resolveUser
dataSource.zh: 核心 SDK 的插件 present / detail 结果；用户名字由宿主的 resolveUser 提供

description.en: The core SDK's resolved view (ResolvedPluginView): title, fields and actions (v1), plus blocks, inputs and detail (v2). The kit reads no paths and evaluates nothing.
description.zh: 核心 SDK 解析后的视图（ResolvedPluginView）：标题、fields、actions（v1），以及 blocks、inputs、detail（v2）。Kit 不读路径、不求值。

description.en: Kit icon name drawn before the title (the plugin's icon); no icon when omitted.
description.zh: 标题前的 Kit 图标名（插件图标）；不传则不画。

description.en: The card envelope's displayName (PluginMessage.displayName, the plugin's name): leads the unavailable reason line ("Poll · This plugin is turned off").
description.zh: 卡片信封里的 displayName（PluginMessage.displayName，插件名）：不可用时放在原因行前面（「投票 · 插件已停用」）。

description.en: The viewer's user id: entries rows of that user carry the me tag.
description.zh: 当前用户 id：entries 里属于该用户的行带「我」标识。

description.en: The whole card is busy (an unresolved command): every action, choice and form submit is disabled.
description.zh: 整张卡片忙（命令未决）：所有动作、选项和表单提交禁用。

description.en: The action in flight: its key (or the choices submit key) shows the spinner and every other control is disabled. Leaving the action settles it as a fallback (settleToken is the explicit signal).
description.zh: 执行中的动作：它的按钮（或 choices 的提交键）转圈，其他控件禁用。离开该动作时作为兜底结算（显式信号是 settleToken）。

description.en: Failure text from the host, shown at the bottom of the card (and in an open form); a new non-empty value reverts an optimistic choice.
description.zh: 宿主传入的失败文案，显示在卡片底部（打开的表单里也显示）；变为非空时撤回乐观选中。

description.en: Drop the card shell and the title row: the detail sheet and admin pages draw the view inside their own surface. An unavailable embedded view still says what it was: its title as one secondary line.
description.zh: 去掉卡片外壳和标题行：详情面板和管理页把视图画在自己的容器里。不可用的 embedded 视图仍说明它是什么：标题作为一行次要文字显示。

description.en: Where the view sits: none (the host's surface pads it); sheet — straight in the kit BottomSheet: spacing md on top, lg at the sides and xl at the bottom, the same as PluginForm, so it needs no wrapper; sheetTop — at the top of a sheet with more under it (a preface above PluginForm): md on top, lg at the sides and nothing at the bottom, so the next part's own top inset is the gap. It pads whatever the view draws, in every state: the embedded body (available or not) and a card shell a host keeps in a sheet (outside the shell, which keeps its own padding).
description.zh: 视图所在位置的内边距：none（由宿主的容器负责）；sheet —— 直接放进 Kit BottomSheet：上 md、左右 lg、下 xl，与 PluginForm 一致，不用再包一层；sheetTop —— 放在面板顶部、下面还有内容（PluginForm 上方的前言）：上 md、左右 lg、下不留，间距由下一部分自己的上边距给出。它作用于视图画出的一切、任何状态：embedded 的内容（可用或不可用），以及宿主留在面板里的卡片外壳（加在外壳外面，外壳自己的内边距不变）。

description.en: How a rows block draws: table — the kit DataTable (the console's admin lists); list — one item per row with its badge, cells and action keys, at most once per key (PluginPage passes it). Vue only: the native kits draw rows as the list.
description.zh: rows 块的画法：table —— Kit DataTable（控制台管理列表）；list —— 每行一项，带徽标、单元格与动作键，同一个 key 只画一次（PluginPage 传它）。只在 Vue：原生三端的 rows 就是列表。

description.en: Name and avatar of a user id in people and entries; may answer from a cache or later. Without an answer the avatar draws initials and the name is the id's last 4 characters.
description.zh: people 和 entries 里 userId 的名字和头像；可以同步返回缓存，也可以异步。取不到时显示首字母头像，名字用 userId 的末 4 位。

description.en: Candidates for members inputs in an action's form (the conversation's members).
description.zh: 动作表单里 members 输入的候选成员（会话成员）。

description.en: The host's validation errors (core SDK validate_form) for the open action form, shown under their inputs.
description.zh: 宿主（核心 SDK 的 validate_form）返回的表单错误，显示在对应输入下方。

description.en: The host's settle signal: an integer it increments once every time an action it ran has finished (after setting error / formErrors for that result). Each change settles the card: no error and no formErrors → a submitted form closes and an optimistic choice stays marked until the new view arrives; error → the optimistic choice reverts (an open form stays and shows it); formErrors → the form stays open with them (a choice it carries reverts). busyActionId leaving the action still settles as a fallback, but a host that sets and clears busyActionId in one frame settles only through this token.
description.zh: 宿主的结算信号：一个整数，宿主每完成一次动作（并把这次结果的 error / formErrors 设好之后）就加 1。每次变化都结算卡片：没有 error 和 formErrors → 关闭已提交的表单面板，乐观选中保留到新视图到达；有 error → 撤回乐观选中（打开的表单留着并显示它）；有 formErrors → 表单留着并显示错误（表单携带的选中一并撤回）。busyActionId 离开该动作仍作为兜底结算；宿主在同一帧里设上又清掉 busyActionId 时，只能靠这个令牌结算。

keyboardBehavior: Tab moves through the expand key, the options, the submit key, see all and the action keys
Enter or Space activates an option, a key or a row
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Result bars and the countdown change without animation when the platform asks for reduced motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: A group named by the title. Options are buttons (single) or checkboxes (multiple) that read their label, selected state, percentage and votes; progress reads value of total; the countdown is not a live region (it is read on focus); the error is an alert.

notes.en: Render facts follow spec/plugin-view-vectors.json (views, optimistic, time, countdown). Shell: the business card of the kit — width sizes.component.richCardWidth (constrained by the parent), radius lg, a hairline border and the card shadow; the title row carries the icon. Actions: style danger → danger key, primary → primary key, otherwise secondary; confirm → the kit DangerConfirm first; form → the kit bottom sheet with PluginForm, whose submit emits action(id, {formValues}). Choices: single submits on tap; multiple toggles a draft and submits from a key labelled with the block's action. The kit marks the submitted options at once and reverts when error becomes non-empty (or busyActionId clears with an error); a new view settles it. Payload: {selection?, formValues?} (Vue rows add row: {key, input}). openDetail comes from "see all" (Vue rows: from a row, with {key, input}) or from the card's view details key, and the host opens PluginDetailSheet. View details: when view.detail is true and no entries block shows its see all, an available card that is not embedded and has no rows block draws a full-width quiet text key (size sm, pluginViewDetail / Vue pluginView.detail) under the action keys; it emits openDetail with no row, waits while busy or busyActionId is set, and needs a host that handles openDetail (spec/plugin-view-vectors.json rules.detailKey, detailKey). Time is formatted in the device zone with pluginViewDateTimeFormat; countdown refreshes every second under an hour and every minute otherwise. Rows: on a plugin page a list on every kit (rowsLayout list, rules.pageRows); in the Vue console (rowsLayout table) FlareDataTable with row actions, a row click for the detail, load more (loadMore(cursor, source)) and the empty text. Settling: the explicit signal is settleToken (the host increments it once per finished action, after setting that result's error / formErrors); busyActionId leaving the action is the fallback, and a host that sets and clears busyActionId within one frame settles only through the token (spec/plugin-view-vectors.json optimistic, rules.settle). Inset: sheet pads the view with spacing md / lg / xl (top / sides / bottom) like PluginForm, for a view placed straight into the kit BottomSheet; sheetTop pads md / lg / 0 for a view with more of the sheet under it (a preface above PluginForm), so the two meet at the form's own md and not at xl + md. Both pad every state — the embedded body, available or not (an unavailable embedded view shows its title as one secondary line), and a card shell a host keeps in a sheet (spec/plugin-view-vectors.json rules.inset, insets). Admin filters (Vue): a rows block's filters names the view inputs the page shows as its filter bar, every input when absent; the other inputs are only collected by row actions' forms. flarePluginFilterInputs(view) returns them in document order (spec/plugin-view-vectors.json filterInputs). Protocol v2 shape: view.menuActions open from a kit ⋯ key at the end of the title row (embedded: keys after view.actions) and run like buttons; grouped entries draw a header row "label · N votes · P%" before the first item of each group, number within the group and tag the viewer's row "me"; view.unavailableReason (disabled, not_installed, no_permission, unsupported_platform, incompatible_version, catalog_unreachable, unbound_copy) adds its localized line after the title, led by displayName; unbound_copy stays readable and read-only. The card shell is the message's card surface: the timeline draws no bubble around it, and a quoted reply goes in the shell's quote slot. Facts in spec/plugin-view-vectors.json (menuActions, entriesGrouped, unavailableReason, shell). Badges: an entry or a row with badge {text, tone} draws it as the kit tag in the tone (entries: after the name and me tag, before the text; list rows: before the first cell; table rows: in the first cell); an unknown tone is neutral (rules.badge). Choices limit: a multiple choice with maxSelections disables every option outside the draft once the draft holds that many (ticked ones still untick), submits only a draft within the cap and leads the footer with "Choose up to {n}" while it can be chosen (rules.maxSelections, maxSelections). The ⋯ key of menuActions sits at the trailing edge of the title row, which spans the card's inner width. A choices block never draws its total (only the shares' denominator): its footer is the maxSelections hint and Ended.
notes.zh: 渲染事实以 spec/plugin-view-vectors.json 为准（views、optimistic、time、countdown）。外壳与 Kit 业务卡片一致：宽度 sizes.component.richCardWidth（服从父约束）、圆角 lg、细边框和卡片阴影，标题行带图标位。动作：style 为 danger 用危险键，primary 用主键，其余为次要键；有 confirm 先弹 Kit 的 DangerConfirm；有 form 打开 Kit 底部面板里的 PluginForm，提交时发出 action(id, {formValues})。choices：单选点一项立即提交；多选勾选后点提交键，键名取块持有的动作 label。Kit 先乐观标记提交的选项，error 变为非空（或 busyActionId 清空时带着 error）时撤回，新视图到达即结算。payload 为 {selection?, formValues?}（Vue 的 rows 另有 row: {key, input}）。「查看全部」或卡片的「查看详情」发出 openDetail（Vue 的 rows 点行时带 {key, input}），宿主打开 PluginDetailSheet。查看详情：view.detail 为真且没有 entries 块在显示「查看全部」时，可用、非 embedded、没有 rows 块的卡片在动作区下方画一个整宽的 quiet 文字按钮（size sm，pluginViewDetail / Vue 的 pluginView.detail），点击发出不带 row 的 openDetail；busy 或 busyActionId 时禁用；宿主要处理 openDetail 才显示（spec/plugin-view-vectors.json 的 rules.detailKey 与 detailKey）。时间按设备时区用 pluginViewDateTimeFormat 格式化；倒计时剩余不到 1 小时每秒刷新，否则每分钟刷新。rows（管理页）只在 Vue：FlareDataTable 加行动作、点行打开详情、加载更多（loadMore(cursor, source)）和空态。结算：显式信号是 settleToken（宿主每完成一次动作加 1，并且先设好这次结果的 error / formErrors）；busyActionId 离开该动作是兜底；宿主在同一帧里设上又清掉 busyActionId 时，只能靠令牌结算（spec/plugin-view-vectors.json 的 optimistic 与 rules.settle）。内边距：inset 为 sheet 时按 PluginForm 的 md / lg / xl（上 / 左右 / 下）留白，供直接放进 Kit BottomSheet 的视图使用；sheetTop 留 md / lg / 0，供下面还有面板内容的视图（PluginForm 上方的前言），两者之间只剩表单自己的 md，不再是 xl + md。两者作用于所有状态 —— embedded 的内容，可用或不可用（不可用的 embedded 视图把标题显示为一行次要文字），以及宿主留在面板里的卡片外壳（spec/plugin-view-vectors.json 的 rules.inset 与 insets）。管理页筛选（Vue）：rows 块的 filters 列出页面筛选栏要显示的视图输入，不带时为全部输入；其余输入只由行动作的表单收集。flarePluginFilterInputs(view) 按文档顺序返回它们（spec/plugin-view-vectors.json 的 filterInputs）。协议 v2 形状：view.menuActions 由标题行末尾的 Kit ⋯ 键打开（内嵌时排在 view.actions 之后作为按钮），执行方式与按钮相同；分组 entries 在每组第一条前插组头行「选项 · N 票 · P%」，组内编号，当前用户那行带「我」；view.unavailableReason（disabled、not_installed、no_permission、unsupported_platform、incompatible_version、catalog_unreachable、unbound_copy）在标题后加一行本地化原因，前面是 displayName；unbound_copy 照常显示但只读。卡片外壳就是消息的 card 表面：时间线不在外面再套气泡，引用回复画在外壳的 quote 插槽里。事实见 spec/plugin-view-vectors.json（menuActions、entriesGrouped、unavailableReason、shell）。 徽标：带 badge {text, tone} 的条目或行，用对应语义色的 Kit 标签画出（entries 在名字与「我」之后、正文之前；列表形式的行在第一格之前；表格形式在第一格内）；未知 tone 按 neutral（rules.badge）。多选上限：带 maxSelections 的多选在草稿达到上限后禁用草稿以外的选项（已选的仍可取消），只提交不超过上限的草稿，可选时页脚以「最多选 {n} 项」开头（rules.maxSelections、maxSelections）。menuActions 的 ⋯ 键贴在标题行尾，标题行占满卡片内宽。choices 块不画 total（它只是百分比的分母）：页脚只有多选上限提示与「已结束」。

slotReasons.quote: Flutter and SwiftUI have no quote parameter: the timeline hands the row's quote to the card through the ambient FlareCardQuote (Flutter) / flareMessageCardQuote environment (SwiftUI), and PluginView draws it inside its shell above the title row, so a host renderer gets it without passing anything.

summary.en: Plugin form — the resolved inputs of a plugin action (text, textarea, number, toggle, select, datetime, options, members) with light client checks and the host's errors; put it in the kit bottom sheet.
summary.zh: 插件表单 —— 插件动作的解析后输入（文本、多行、数字、开关、单选、日期时间、选项列表、成员），客户端轻校验加宿主错误；放进 Kit 底部面板。

dataSource.en: the resolved view's inputs (the ones an action's form names, or a composer action's); errors from the core SDK's validate_form
dataSource.zh: 解析后视图的 inputs（动作 form 列出的，或 composer 动作的）；错误来自核心 SDK 的 validate_form

description.en: The inputs, in order (resolved UiInput: labels translated, initial values in default).
description.zh: 要收集的输入，按顺序（解析后的 UiInput：文案已翻译，初值在 default）。

description.en: Initial values by input id; an input without one starts from its default.
description.zh: 按输入 id 的初值；没有的取 default。

description.en: The host's errors (UiFormError), shown under their inputs until that input is edited; they win over the client check.
description.zh: 宿主返回的错误（UiFormError），显示在对应输入下方，直到该输入被修改；优先于客户端校验。

description.en: The submit key; pluginViewSubmit ("提交") when omitted.
description.zh: 提交键文案；不传时为 pluginViewSubmit（「提交」）。

description.en: Submitting: fields and both keys are locked and the submit key shows the spinner.
description.zh: 提交中：输入和两个按钮锁定，提交键转圈。

description.en: A failure line above the keys (the host's text).
description.zh: 按钮上方的失败文案（宿主传入）。

description.en: Candidates for members inputs, picked with the kit ContactPicker (max 1 picks one).
description.zh: members 输入的候选成员，用 Kit 的 ContactPicker 选择（max 为 1 时单选）。

keyboardBehavior: Tab moves through the inputs, the option rows' remove keys, add option, Cancel and Submit
Enter in a single-line field does not submit; Enter or Space activates the keys
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: No motion beyond the kit inputs and sheet.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Each input is named by its label and marked required; its error is described by the field and announced as an alert; the length counter is read as part of the field; the members field reads the chosen names.

notes.en: Client check and submitted values follow spec/plugin-view-vectors.json → form: required and length only (Unicode code points, trimmed), shown for an input once edited and for all after a submit attempt; the core SDK's errors are final. Controls: text and textarea with a counter, number, toggle (Switch), select as a single-choice list (RadioGroup), datetime (Vue: the kit DatePicker and TimePicker; natives: the platform picker), options as rows with add (addOption) and remove (removeOption) inside [max(min, 1), max], members through ContactPicker. Issue texts: pluginFormRequired, pluginFormTooLong, pluginFormOutOfRange, pluginFormTooFewItems / pluginFormTooManyItems ({n} from min / max), pluginFormDuplicateItem, otherwise pluginFormInvalid.
notes.zh: 客户端校验和提交值以 spec/plugin-view-vectors.json → form 为准：只查必填和长度（按 Unicode 码点、去首尾空白），输入改过后即时提示、点提交后全部提示；最终以核心 SDK 的错误为准。控件：text、textarea 带计数；number；toggle（Switch）；select 为单选列表（RadioGroup）；datetime（Vue 用 Kit 的 DatePicker 和 TimePicker，原生用平台选择器）；options 为可增删的行（addOption、removeOption），条数在 [max(min, 1), max] 内；members 用 ContactPicker。错误文案：pluginFormRequired、pluginFormTooLong、pluginFormOutOfRange、pluginFormTooFewItems / pluginFormTooManyItems（{n} 取 min / max）、pluginFormDuplicateItem，其余为 pluginFormInvalid。

notes.en: The detail view is rendered by PluginView with embedded true (no card shell, no title row), so blocks, actions and their forms behave as on the card. Flutter: FlarePluginDetailSheet is the content and FlarePluginDetailSheet.show presents it on the kit sheet under a title; SwiftUI: PluginDetailSheetView inside flareBottomSheet(isPresented:title:); Compose: PluginDetailSheet composes the kit BottomSheet and reports onClose. Detail actions: busyActionId, actionError (as the view's error), formErrors, members and settleToken go to the embedded PluginView unchanged, so an action run from the detail spins, fails, collects its form and settles inside the sheet. The host keeps them apart from the card's own busy and error, so a failure in the detail never lands on the card below. Paging: a detail view with a non-blank nextCursor shows a full-width load-more key under the embedded view (Vue pluginView.loadMore, natives myInviteLoadMore); a tap emits loadMore(cursor), the host fetches that page and passes back the merged view (the core SDK appends pages: entries pair up and number on; the kit merges nothing), and the key goes away with the last page (absent or blank nextCursor). The key spins and is disabled while loadingMore is true or while the cursor the kit last asked for is still the view's nextCursor, so one page is never asked for twice; a merged view with a new cursor makes it tappable again, and the kit forgets the asked cursor (allowing a retry) when loadingMore goes from true to false, when settleToken changes or when actionError becomes non-empty. A failure is shown through actionError. Rules and samples: spec/plugin-view-vectors.json detailPaging.
notes.zh: detail 视图由 embedded 为真的 PluginView 渲染（无卡片外壳、无标题行），块、动作和表单的行为与卡片一致。Flutter：FlarePluginDetailSheet 是内容，FlarePluginDetailSheet.show 在 Kit 面板上带标题呈现；SwiftUI：PluginDetailSheetView 放进 flareBottomSheet(isPresented:title:)；Compose：PluginDetailSheet 组合 Kit BottomSheet 并回调 onClose。详情里的动作：busyActionId、actionError（作为视图的 error）、formErrors、members、settleToken 原样交给内嵌 PluginView，详情里的动作在面板内转圈、出错、收表单、结算。宿主要把它们和卡片自己的 busy、error 分开，详情里的失败不会落到面板下面的卡片上。分页：detail 视图带非空的 nextCursor 时，在内嵌视图下方画一行整宽的「加载更多」（Vue 为 pluginView.loadMore，原生为 myInviteLoadMore）；点击发出 loadMore(cursor)，宿主取下一页后把合并好的视图传回（合并由核心 SDK 做：entries 依次接上、序号续排；Kit 不合并），最后一页（nextCursor 不存在或为空白）时按钮消失。loadingMore 为真，或 Kit 记下的已请求游标仍等于当前 nextCursor 时，按钮转圈并禁用，同一页不会被请求两次；合并后的视图换了游标即恢复可点；loadingMore 由真变假、settleToken 变化或 actionError 变为非空时，Kit 清掉已请求的游标，允许重试。失败经 actionError 显示。规则与样例见 spec/plugin-view-vectors.json 的 detailPaging。

notes.en: The page host for any plugin `page` contribution — the red packet wallet and its history (docs/design/red-packet-v5-roles-and-wallet.md §3.2). The kit Screen with the heading (view.title, else the host's title: an unavailable page keeps the host's) and back key, then the filter tabs, the view drawn by PluginView embedded (the detail sheet's document renderer: blocks, menu actions as keys, forms and settling behave the same; rows draw as a list with their badges, at most once per key, and only the row that ran an action spins) and a full-width load-more key while view.nextCursor is non-blank (asked once per cursor, as in PluginDetailSheet; the end of a refresh also forgets the asked cursor). Pull to refresh on touch and a refresh key in the header on pointer devices. Data and actions: view.data is what the page was resolved against; every action run on the page — a view action, a menu action, a choices submit, a row action, after its confirm and form — emits action(id, {page, data?, row?, selection?, formValues?}), the request invokePageAction takes, so the host passes it through and routes the outcome (a page target opens the next page with its payload as the arguments). Paging: loadMore(cursor) asks for the next page; the host passes back the merged view from the core SDK (new rows and entries after the shown ones, shown row keys dropped, data kept). Filters: the select inputs the rows block lists (every input when it lists none) are FilterTabs rows, all first; choosing a tab emits filter(values) with the host's filters updated, and the host re-reads the first page. Unavailable (view.available false): the kit empty state with the reason's copy, a retry key only for catalog_unreachable, nothing else. The host fetches: refresh, retry, loadMore and filter are requests; the kit calls nothing and draws nothing the view does not declare. A page has no openDetail (a page view has no detail). Facts in spec/plugin-view-vectors.json (rules.page, pageRows, pagePaging, pageFilters; pageViews, pageActions, pagePaging, pageFilters).
notes.zh: 任何插件 page 贡献的页面宿主 —— 红包钱包与明细（docs/design/red-packet-v5-roles-and-wallet.md §3.2）。Kit 的 Screen：页头标题取 view.title，没有时取宿主标题（不可用的页面保留宿主标题），带返回键；其下是筛选标签、由内嵌 PluginView 画的视图（与详情面板同一套文档渲染器：块、作为按钮排列的菜单动作、表单与结算行为一致；rows 画成带徽标的列表，同一个 key 只画一次，只有发起动作的那一行转圈），view.nextCursor 非空时视图下方是整宽的「加载更多」（同一游标只请求一次，同 PluginDetailSheet；刷新结束也会忘掉已请求的游标）。触屏下拉刷新，指针设备页头有刷新键。数据与动作：view.data 是页面解析所依据的数据；页面里执行的每个动作 —— 视图动作、菜单动作、choices 提交、行动作，在确认与表单之后 —— 发出 action(id, {page, data?, row?, selection?, formValues?})，即 invokePageAction 的请求，宿主原样转交并处理结果（page 目标用结果的 payload 作为参数打开下一页）。分页：loadMore(cursor) 请求下一页；宿主把核心 SDK 合并好的视图传回（新页的 rows 与 entries 接在已显示的后面，已显示的行 key 丢弃，data 保持）。筛选：rows 块列出的 select 输入（不列时为全部输入）各是一行 FilterTabs，「全部」在前；选中一项发出 filter(values)（宿主的 filters 改好之后的值），宿主重读第一页。不可用（view.available 为假）：Kit 空态显示原因文案，只有 catalog_unreachable 带重试键，其余都不画。取数由宿主负责：refresh、retry、loadMore、filter 都是请求，Kit 不调用任何接口，视图没声明的东西不画。页面没有 openDetail（页面视图没有详情）。事实见 spec/plugin-view-vectors.json（rules.page、pageRows、pagePaging、pageFilters；pageViews、pageActions、pagePaging、pageFilters）。

Enter or Space activates them
The platform back acts as the back key

accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Region named by the heading; each filter row is a tab list named by its input's label; the refresh indicator is a status that announces refreshing; an unavailable page reads its reason; load more is a button named by its label.

summary.en: Account view — the account presentation of a plugin page: a headline balance with secondary statistics that can all be hidden, a ledger grouped by date, and local entry details whose actions reuse PluginView.
summary.zh: 账户视图 —— 插件页面的账户呈现：首要余额与可整体隐藏的次级统计、按日期分组的账单，以及复用 PluginView 动作的本地交易详情。

description.en: The action in flight: its key (or the choices submit key) shows the spinner and every other control is disabled. Leaving the action settles it as a fallback (settleToken is the explicit signal).
description.zh: 执行中的动作：它的按钮（或 choices 的提交键）转圈，其他控件禁用。离开该动作时作为兜底结算（显式信号是 settleToken）。

description.en: Failure text from the host, shown at the bottom of the card (and in an open form); a new non-empty value reverts an optimistic choice.
description.zh: 宿主传入的失败文案，显示在卡片底部（打开的表单里也显示）；变为非空时撤回乐观选中。

description.en: The host's validation errors (core SDK validate_form) for the open action form, shown under their inputs.
description.zh: 宿主（核心 SDK 的 validate_form）返回的表单错误，显示在对应输入下方。

description.en: Candidates for members inputs in an action's form (the conversation's members).
description.zh: 动作表单里 members 输入的候选成员（会话成员）。

description.en: The host's settle signal: an integer it increments once every time an action it ran has finished (after setting error / formErrors for that result). Each change settles the card: no error and no formErrors → a submitted form closes and an optimistic choice stays marked until the new view arrives; error → the optimistic choice reverts (an open form stays and shows it); formErrors → the form stays open with them (a choice it carries reverts). busyActionId leaving the action still settles as a fallback, but a host that sets and clears busyActionId in one frame settles only through this token.
description.zh: 宿主的结算信号：一个整数，宿主每完成一次动作（并把这次结果的 error / formErrors 设好之后）就加 1。每次变化都结算卡片：没有 error 和 formErrors → 关闭已提交的表单面板，乐观选中保留到新视图到达；有 error → 撤回乐观选中（打开的表单留着并显示它）；有 formErrors → 表单留着并显示错误（表单携带的选中一并撤回）。busyActionId 离开该动作仍作为兜底结算；宿主在同一帧里设上又清掉 busyActionId 时，只能靠这个令牌结算。

description.en: Name and avatar of a user id in people and entries; may answer from a cache or later. Without an answer the avatar draws initials and the name is the id's last 4 characters.
description.zh: people 和 entries 里 userId 的名字和头像；可以同步返回缓存，也可以异步。取不到时显示首字母头像，名字用 userId 的末 4 位。

description.en: The viewer's user id: entries rows of that user carry the me tag.
description.zh: 当前用户 id：entries 里属于该用户的行带「我」标识。

notes.en: Shared facts follow spec/account-view-vectors.json. PluginPage draws it when appearance is account (or a resolved presentation.renderer is account); hosts normally reach it through PluginPage, which keeps loading, unavailable reasons, refresh, filters and cursor pagination. The eye control hides every overview value (and row amounts when presentation.props.maskRowAmounts is set) and announces the hidden state. Each entry opens local details with its original columns, type, amount and row key; only actions both declared by the block and bound by the row are offered, and confirms, forms, busy and error signals are PluginView's. Rows are deduplicated by block and row key, keeping the first. See docs/account-page-ui.md.
notes.zh: 共同事实见 spec/account-view-vectors.json。PluginPage 在 appearance 为 account（或解析出的 presentation.renderer 为 account）时绘制它；宿主一般经 PluginPage 使用，加载、不可用原因、刷新、筛选与游标分页仍归 PluginPage。眼睛按钮隐藏全部概览金额（presentation.props.maskRowAmounts 为真时连行金额一起隐藏），并播报隐藏状态。每条记录打开本地详情，显示原始列、类型、金额与行键；只提供块声明且该行绑定的动作，确认、表单、忙碌与错误信号沿用 PluginView。行按块与行键去重，保留第一条。见 docs/account-page-ui.md。

keyboardBehavior: Tab reaches the hide-balance key, the page actions, each ledger entry and the account information disclosure in reading order
Enter or Space activates them; entries are disabled while an action is busy
Escape and the platform back close an open entry's details sheet
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: No motion of its own; the details sheet follows the kit bottom sheet.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: The overview is named by the headline label and the ledger by its section title. While hidden the headline reads as hidden and the eye key's name switches between show and hide. Each entry is a button carrying its type, description, amount and time. Warning and danger notices stay visible; the account rules sit behind a disclosure.

keyboardBehavior: Tab moves through Cancel, the locate key, the search field, the place rows and Send

accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: A group named "Location"; the place rows are a radio group (one checked); locating, denied and no-result messages are polite live regions; the map is an image named by the chosen place.

notes.en: Put it in the kit BottomSheet with `fill` (it declares its own header, so the sheet draws no second title). The first row is the current location (id "current"): its title comes from reverseGeocode, else "Current location", and its address from the reverse geocode, else the coordinate line. Selecting a row moves the map; `send` returns the selected FlareLocationPlace, and the host builds the location message (and its snapshot) from it. The coordinate line and the distance labels follow spec/location-vectors.json (label, distance). Searches are debounced 300 ms; Return searches at once. The picker never asks for permission itself: requestCurrentLocation is the host's platform adapter. With provider osm the map preview carries OpenStreetMap's credit (ODbL): locationOsmAttribution ("© OpenStreetMap contributors", the same in every language) as a small line in the bottom-right corner of the picture, secondary text on a translucent ground, clear of the centre marker; not while the map is unavailable, and never for amap. Permission and sending: with ensurePermission the picker shows locating while the host's prompt is up and starts the locateTimeoutMs clock only after it resolves true; false is denied at once. `sending` locks the Send key (spinner, disabled) while the host sends; the host clears it when the send settles. previewUrl's width and height are device pixels on every platform: round(logical × clamp(scale, 1, 2)) (spec/location-vectors.json previewSize). On the web, Vue's `createFlareBrowserLocationHost()` (./utils) is the browser and webview adapter for the two callbacks: `ensurePermission` reads the Permissions API, and while the answer is prompt (or the browser cannot say) shows the browser's prompt through one position request; only a refusal is false, and a page without a secure context or without navigator.geolocation is false at once. `requestCurrentLocation` reads navigator.geolocation and first takes the fix the prompt step already got; it rejects on an insecure page, without the API, on a refusal and on no fix in time.
notes.zh: 放进带 `fill` 的 Kit BottomSheet（组件声明自带标题，面板不再画第二个标题）。第一行是当前位置（id 为 "current"）：标题取逆地址的名称，没有时为「当前位置」；地址取逆地址，没有时为坐标行。选中某行时地图跟着移动；`send` 回传选中的 FlareLocationPlace，宿主据此构造位置消息（和静态图）。坐标行与距离文案按 spec/location-vectors.json（label、distance）。搜索防抖 300 ms，回车立即搜索。组件不自己申请权限：requestCurrentLocation 是宿主的平台适配。provider 为 osm 时，地图预览上显示 OpenStreetMap 的署名（ODbL）：文案 locationOsmAttribution（「© OpenStreetMap contributors」，各语言相同），在图片右下角一行小字，secondary 文本色、半透明底，不遮中心点；地图不可用时不显示，amap 时不显示。权限与发送：有 ensurePermission 时，宿主的权限弹框期间组件显示定位中，返回 true 后才开始 locateTimeoutMs 计时；返回 false 立即进入 denied。`sending` 在宿主发送期间锁住发送键（转圈、禁用），发送结束后由宿主清掉。previewUrl 的宽高在四端都是设备像素：round(逻辑尺寸 × clamp(倍率, 1, 2))（spec/location-vectors.json 的 previewSize）。在网页里，Vue 的 `createFlareBrowserLocationHost()`（./utils）是浏览器与 webview 的两个回调适配：`ensurePermission` 先查 Permissions API，结果为 prompt（或浏览器答不上来）时发起一次定位请求来弹出浏览器的授权框；只有拒绝算 false，没有安全上下文或没有 navigator.geolocation 的页面直接为 false。`requestCurrentLocation` 读 navigator.geolocation，授权那一步已经拿到的定位先用；非安全页面、没有该 API、被拒或超时没有定位时失败。

notes.en: `select` always carries a list: one entry on a tap in single mode, the chosen entries (in the order they were chosen) from the confirm key in multiple mode. The list builds only the rows on screen (Vue windows lists longer than 60 rows; the native kits use their lazy lists). The signed-in user (isSelf) stays selectable. Multiple mode's confirm key reuses the kit's confirm word. Own header: it draws its own header (Cancel, the title, the confirm key in multiple mode) and declares it, so put it in the kit BottomSheet with `fill` and the sheet keeps its title as the accessible name only. Sending: the host sets `sending` from `select` until the send settles, then clears it (and closes the sheet after a send that went through). The busy row is announced as in progress; Cancel, the search and the tabs stay usable — the sheet's own lock (dismissible, busy) decides whether the picker can be closed meanwhile.
notes.zh: `select` 总是列表：单选时点一行回传一项；多选时由确认键按选中顺序回传。列表只构建屏幕上的行（Vue 超过 60 行开始开窗，原生用各自的懒加载列表）。自己（isSelf）也可以选。多选确认键复用 Kit 的「确定」。自带标题：组件自己画标题栏（取消、标题、多选时的确认键）并声明这一点，放进带 `fill` 的 Kit BottomSheet 时，面板的 title 只作可及名称。发送中：宿主从 `select` 起设上 `sending`，发送结束后清掉（发送成功则关闭面板）。转圈的那一行读屏报进行中；取消、搜索和分组标签照常可用 —— 发送期间能否关闭由面板自己的锁（dismissible、busy）决定。

notes.en: A host that listens for `cancel` gets the search bar's own way out beside the field; on the native kits a search page is pushed onto the platform's navigation stack, whose bar already carries the way out, so the event is Vue only. The Vue `idle` slot replaces the idle line and is handed `search(term)`, which searches for a term at once and puts the caret back in the field, and `focusField()` for a slot action that removes what had focus — [RecentSearches](/en/components/recent-searches) goes here; put `v-if` on the `<template #idle>` itself, because a slot that renders nothing still replaces the idle line. A result group with `hasMore` draws a countless more row ("See more" on Vue, the existing `more` string on the native kits). On Vue, when its kind is also a type id the panel switches to that type itself and still reports `viewAll`; the native panels only report `onViewAll` (their chosen type is private state too, so a host remounts the panel keyed on the new `criteria.filterId`, or pushes its own list). `snapshot.warning` (Vue only; the native snapshots have no such field yet) is said above results that came back incomplete, with a retry. `layout="page"` (Vue and Flutter `FlareSearchPanelLayout.page`) needs a height from its host: a non-scrolling screen gives one, a sheet or Modal only caps its own, so inside one wrap the panel in a box with a height or use Modal `fill`.
notes.zh: 宿主监听 `cancel` 时，搜索框旁边出现它自带的出口（取消）；原生端的搜索页是压进平台导航栈的，导航栏本来就带着出口，所以这个事件仅 Vue。Vue 的 `idle` 插槽替换空闲提示并拿到 `search(term)`（立即搜索这个词并把光标放回输入框）与 `focusField()`（插槽里的动作把持有焦点的东西移走时调用）——[RecentSearches](/components/recent-searches) 放在这里；`v-if` 要写在 `<template #idle>` 上，因为渲染为空的插槽同样会顶掉空闲提示。结果分组带 `hasMore` 时画一条不带数的更多行（Vue 是「查看更多」，原生三端用既有的 `more` 字符串）。在 Vue 上，分组的 kind 同时也是类型 id 时面板自己切到该类型，并照旧上报 `viewAll`；原生面板只上报 `onViewAll`（它们的类型同样是私有状态，宿主用新的 `criteria.filterId` 作 key 重建面板，或推入自己的列表）。`snapshot.warning`（仅 Vue；原生快照还没有这个字段）写在不完整的结果上方，带重试。`layout="page"`（Vue 与 Flutter `FlareSearchPanelLayout.page`）需要宿主给高度：不滚动的整页给得了，面板或 Modal 只封顶自己，所以放进去时要用一个定高的盒子包住面板，或用 Modal 的 `fill`。

notes.en: Ask-and-await presenters with busy, error and retry: Vue `useFlareConfirm` (FlareUiProvider), Flutter `FlareDangerConfirm.show(context, ..., action:)`, iOS `await FlareFeedback.confirm(FlareConfirmOptions(..., action:))`. A failing action keeps the dialog open with the error; the answer resolves true only after the action succeeds. Every presenter follows BottomSheet auto: a sheet on the phone form factor, Modal elsewhere, with scrim, drag, Escape and back locked while the action runs. Flutter's `confirmText` / `cancelText` default to FlareStrings confirm / cancel. Compose DangerConfirm hosts itself in `BottomSheet(presentation = Auto)`; `LocalFlareDialog.current.confirm(FlareConfirmOptions(..., action =))` is the ask-and-await presenter (inside FlareToastHost). Vue's `reason` and `confirmPhrase` (also on `useFlareConfirm` options) hold the confirm key until a reason is given (within `maxBytes` of UTF-8) and the phrase is typed; `confirm` emits `{ reason }` and the presenter passes it to `action`, keeping what was typed when the action fails. They serve web consoles; the native presenters keep the plain confirmation.
notes.zh: 询问并等待结果的呈现器，带忙碌、错误与重试：Vue `useFlareConfirm`（FlareUiProvider）、Flutter `FlareDangerConfirm.show(context, ..., action:)`、iOS `await FlareFeedback.confirm(FlareConfirmOptions(..., action:))`。动作失败时对话框保留并显示错误；只有动作成功后结果才为 true。各端呈现器都遵循 BottomSheet auto：手机形态为底部面板，其它形态为 Modal，动作进行中遮罩、拖拽、Escape 与返回都被锁住。Flutter 的 `confirmText` / `cancelText` 默认取 FlareStrings 的 confirm / cancel。Compose DangerConfirm 自己托管在 `BottomSheet(presentation = Auto)` 里；`LocalFlareDialog.current.confirm(FlareConfirmOptions(..., action =))` 是询问并等待结果的呈现器（在 FlareToastHost 之内）。 Vue 的 `reason` 与 `confirmPhrase`（`useFlareConfirm` 的选项里也有）在填好原因（UTF-8 不超过 `maxBytes`）并输入确认文字之前不放开确认键；`confirm` 上报 `{ reason }`，呈现器把它交给 `action`，动作失败时保留已输入的内容。它们服务于 Web 控制台；原生端呈现器保持普通确认。

accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: The title is the page heading and names the form region; the back key is named by backLabel. The brand panel repeats the product copy and is hidden from assistive technology.

notes.en: The layout follows the shell's own width: at `appShellCompactMinWidth` (900) and wider the brand panel sits beside the form; below it the brand lockup moves above the heading and the headline and description are not drawn. Vue passes the form in the default slot, Flutter as `child`, SwiftUI and Compose as `content`. The kit owns the composition and the heading hierarchy only; fields, validation and submission stay in the app.
notes.zh: 布局按骨架自身宽度切换：`appShellCompactMinWidth`（900）及以上品牌面板在表单旁；以下品牌标识移到标题上方，不画大标题与说明。表单在 Vue 走默认插槽，Flutter 走 `child`，SwiftUI 与 Compose 走 `content`。组件库只负责版式与标题层级；字段、校验与提交留在应用里。

summary.en: Adaptive bottom sheet — the surface for short, focused tasks (pickers, forms, confirms, prompts): a bottom sheet on the phone form factor, and on other form factors the same content handed to Modal as a centered box; focus return, scroll lock, optional title and height cap.

description.en: Prevent closing while an operation owns the draft (scrim, drag, Escape and back no longer close it). Flutter expresses it through `FlareBottomSheet.show(dismissible:, busy:)`, iOS through `flareBottomSheet(dismissible:)` and the `FlareLayerDismissDisabledKey` preference.

description.zh: 高度上限。Vue 为 CSS 长度（默认 "72vh"）；原生为逻辑像素（Flutter double、iOS CGFloat、Compose Dp），不传即可用高度（扣除键盘与安全区后）的 72%。内容自己负责滚动，面板只给出有界约束。
description.en: Height cap. Vue takes a CSS length (default "72vh"); natives take logical pixels (Flutter double, iOS CGFloat, Compose Dp) and default to 72% of the available height after the keyboard and safe area. The content owns its scrolling; the surface only gives it bounded constraints.

description.zh: 呈现方式：auto 在手机形态（平台能力 bottomSheet）为底部面板，其它形态把内容交给 Modal 居中呈现（委托，不是第二套对话框实现）；sheet 总是底部面板。auto 在打开时判定一次，关闭前不再改变。需要居中弹窗用 Modal，需要侧边面板用 Drawer —— 原来的 dialog / drawer 取值已移除。iOS 由 `flareBottomSheet(presentation:)` 表达。
description.en: How it appears: auto is a bottom sheet on the phone form factor (platform capability bottomSheet) and otherwise hands the content to Modal as a centered box (delegation, not a second dialog implementation); sheet is always a bottom sheet. auto is resolved once when the sheet opens and kept until it closes. Use Modal for a centered box and Drawer for a side panel — the former dialog and drawer values are removed. iOS expresses it through `flareBottomSheet(presentation:)`.

description.zh: 只把 title 当可及名称用，不画那行可见标题：动作面板里每一条都是一句完整的动作，再写一遍面板叫什么只是重复刚点过的按钮。
description.en: Use title as the accessible name only, without drawing the visible heading: in an action panel every row is already a whole action.

description.zh: 定高模式：面板占满自己的高度上限（maxHeight，不传为可用高度的 72%），内容撑满标题下方的剩余高度并自己负责滚动，宿主不再写定高容器。用于自带标题栏、需要定高的内容（LocationPicker、ContactPicker）。fill 时内容可声明「自带标题」，面板就不画可见标题，title 只作可及名称（见 notes）。交给 Modal 呈现时同样是 Modal 的 fill。
description.en: Fixed-height mode: the surface takes its whole height cap (maxHeight; 72% of the available height when omitted), the content fills what is left under the title and owns its scrolling, so hosts write no fixed-height wrapper. For content with its own header that needs a definite height (LocationPicker, ContactPicker). With fill, content can declare that it brings its own header; the sheet then draws no visible title and keeps title as the accessible name only (see notes). Handed to Modal, it is Modal's fill.

description.zh: 交给 Modal 呈现时的宽度（转给 FlareModal 的 width）。组件根是 Teleport，宿主的 class 与自定义属性都到不了被传送出去的面上，所以要走 prop。
description.en: Width when the content is handed to Modal (forwarded as FlareModal's width). The component's root is a Teleport, so a host class or custom property never reaches the teleported surface — hence a prop.

keyboardBehavior: Escape closes the sheet when dismissible
Tab is trapped inside the sheet
Focus returns to the opener on close
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: The sheet appears without slide animation; the scrim appears instantly.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Announce the title as the dialog name; the backdrop is inert; the body behind is aria-hidden while open.

notes.en: The kit's surface for short, focused tasks on every platform, so hosts never reach for system sheets. `presentation="auto"` (the default on all four platforms) is a bottom sheet on the phone form factor and otherwise shows the content in Modal; long-lived secondary content belongs in Drawer, not here. Vue renders it from `open` (the form factor is `platform.capabilities.value.bottomSheet`). Flutter presents it with `FlareBottomSheet.show(context, title:, titleHidden:, dismissible:, busy:, maxHeight:, presentation:, fill:, listenable:, builder:)` and `FlareBottomSheet.prompt`; `builder` runs again whenever `listenable` notifies, so content that takes changing host state (a picker's `sending`) stays current without a builder of the host's own, and in fill mode the own-header check runs on every rebuild; the form factor is `flareCapabilitiesOf(context).bottomSheet`. iOS presents it with `flareBottomSheet(isPresented:|item:, title:, titleHidden:, presentation:, dismissible:, size:, maxHeight:, onDismiss:, content:)` around `BottomSheetView` (`size: .large` fills the large detent for search, pickers and flows with their own NavigationStack); presentation and dismissible live on that presenter, not on `BottomSheetView`; the form factor is `@Environment(\.flareCompactOverlays)`, and content locks dismissal with `.flareLayerDismissDisabled(_:)`. Compose composes `BottomSheet(onClose, title, titleHidden, maxHeight, dismissible, presentation) { }`, a dialog window whose content owns its scrolling; `flareCompactOverlays()` is its form-factor resolver. DangerConfirm, FormSheet and prompts follow the same auto rule on all four platforms. Fill mode: with `fill` the surface takes its whole cap and hands the content the rest of the height under the grip (and the title), as Modal's `fill` does; the content owns its scrolling. Content that draws its own header row (a title with Cancel) declares it, and with `fill` the sheet then keeps `title` as the accessible name only: Vue — the content calls `useFlareSheetOwnHeader()` in setup (from `@flare-im/vue-ui/composables`; the kit's LocationPicker and ContactPicker do); Flutter — the widget `FlareBottomSheet.show(fill: true, builder:)` returns implements `FlareSheetOwnHeader` (FlareLocationPicker and FlareContactPicker do); iOS — the content calls the public View modifier `.flareSheetOwnHeader()` (`flareSheetOwnHeader(false)` withdraws it), reported up through the PreferenceKey `FlareSheetOwnHeaderKey` and read by `BottomSheetView(title:titleHidden:maxHeight:fill:content:)` and `flareBottomSheet(isPresented:|item:, …, fill:)`; Compose — the content calls the public `@Composable fun FlareSheetOwnHeader()`, which registers with the CompositionLocal `BottomSheet(…, fill = true)` provides (internally `LocalFlareSheetHeader`) and unregisters when it leaves the composition, and the sheet keeps title as its paneTitle and accessible name. The kit's LocationPickerView / LocationPicker and ContactPickerView / ContactPicker declare it on both. Without `fill`, nothing changes: the title is drawn unless titleHidden.
notes.zh: 各端统一的短任务承载面，宿主不必再调用系统面板。`presentation="auto"`（四端默认）在手机形态为底部面板，其它形态把内容交给 Modal；长驻的次级内容属于 Drawer，不放这里。Vue 由 `open` 呈现（形态判据是 `platform.capabilities.value.bottomSheet`）。Flutter 用 `FlareBottomSheet.show(context, title:, titleHidden:, dismissible:, busy:, maxHeight:, presentation:, fill:, listenable:, builder:)` 与 `FlareBottomSheet.prompt` 呈现；`listenable` 每次通知都重新运行 `builder`，内容里随宿主状态变化的参数（如选择器的 `sending`）随之更新，宿主不必再自己包一层 builder，fill 模式下每次重建都会重新判断内容是否自带标题；形态判据是 `flareCapabilitiesOf(context).bottomSheet`。iOS 用包裹 `BottomSheetView` 的 `flareBottomSheet(isPresented:|item:, title:, titleHidden:, presentation:, dismissible:, size:, maxHeight:, onDismiss:, content:)` 呈现（`size: .large` 占满大档位，用于搜索、选择器与自带 NavigationStack 的流程）；presentation 与 dismissible 在这个呈现器上，不在 `BottomSheetView` 上；形态判据是 `@Environment(\.flareCompactOverlays)`，内容用 `.flareLayerDismissDisabled(_:)` 锁住关闭。Compose 直接组合 `BottomSheet(onClose, title, titleHidden, maxHeight, dismissible, presentation) { }`，它是对话框窗口，内容自己负责滚动；形态判据是 `flareCompactOverlays()`。DangerConfirm、FormSheet 与提示框在四端遵循同一条 auto 规则。定高模式：`fill` 时面板占满自己的上限，把把手（和标题）下方的剩余高度交给内容，与 Modal 的 `fill` 相同；内容自己负责滚动。自带标题栏（标题加「取消」）的内容要声明这一点，`fill` 时面板就只把 `title` 当可及名称：Vue 由内容在 setup 里调用 `useFlareSheetOwnHeader()`（从 `@flare-im/vue-ui/composables` 导入，Kit 的 LocationPicker、ContactPicker 已调用）；Flutter 由 `FlareBottomSheet.show(fill: true, builder:)` 返回的组件实现 `FlareSheetOwnHeader`（FlareLocationPicker、FlareContactPicker 已实现）；iOS 由内容调用公开的 View 修饰符 `.flareSheetOwnHeader()`（`flareSheetOwnHeader(false)` 可撤销），经 PreferenceKey `FlareSheetOwnHeaderKey` 往上报，`BottomSheetView(title:titleHidden:maxHeight:fill:content:)` 与 `flareBottomSheet(isPresented:|item:, …, fill:)` 读取；Compose 由内容调用公开的 `@Composable fun FlareSheetOwnHeader()`，向 `BottomSheet(…, fill = true)` 提供的 CompositionLocal（内部名 `LocalFlareSheetHeader`）登记、离开组合时注销，面板把 title 作为 paneTitle 和可及名称。两端 Kit 的 LocationPickerView / LocationPicker、ContactPickerView / ContactPicker 都声明自带标题。不加 `fill` 时行为不变：除非 titleHidden，标题照画。

summary.zh: 侧边抽屉 —— 从行尾（默认）或行首边滑出的全高模态面板，承载长驻的次级内容（会话 / 群 / 联系人详情、设置栈、资料编辑）；遮罩、焦点陷阱、Escape 与平台返回键、可选返回键与页内导航。
summary.en: Side drawer — a full-height modal panel sliding in from the inline end (default) or start edge, for long-lived secondary content (conversation, group and contact details, settings stacks, the profile editor); scrim, focus trap, Escape and platform back, an optional back control and in-panel navigation.

dataSource.en: passed in by you

description.zh: 是否打开（受控）。
description.en: Whether the drawer is open (controlled).

description.zh: 可选标题，同时是抽屉的可及名称；位于头部行起始。
description.en: Optional header, also the drawer's accessible name; leads the header row.

description.zh: 只把 title 当可及名称用，不画可见标题。
description.en: Use title as the accessible name only, without drawing the heading.

description.zh: 没有可见标题时的可及名称（自带页头的页面式内容）。每个抽屉都要有 title 或 label；原生端兜底为 FlareStrings.drawerLabel。
description.en: Accessible name when there is no visible title (page-like content that brings its own header). Every drawer needs a title or a label; natives fall back to FlareStrings.drawerLabel.

description.zh: 抽屉贴靠的边，按行内方向（随 RTL 翻转）。
description.en: Edge the drawer docks to, in inline (RTL-aware) terms.

description.zh: 面板宽度。默认取 token sizes.component.sheetWidth（420），并夹到「窗口宽 − 触达尺寸」，始终留出一条可点的遮罩；Vue 在手机形态为全宽。Vue 为 CSS 长度；原生为逻辑像素（Flutter double、iOS CGFloat、Compose Dp）。
description.en: Panel width. Defaults to the token sizes.component.sheetWidth (420) and is clamped to the window minus the touch target so a scrim gutter always remains; Vue is full width on the phone form factor. Vue takes a CSS length; natives take logical pixels (Flutter double, iOS CGFloat, Compose Dp).

description.zh: 允许遮罩、Escape、平台返回键与关闭按钮关闭抽屉；false 在操作占用时锁住。
description.en: Allow the scrim, Escape, platform back and the close button to close the drawer; false locks it while an operation owns it.

description.zh: 在头部画关闭按钮（48 触达区，iOS 44pt，标签为 FlareStrings close）；不可关闭时禁用。
description.en: Draw the header close button (a 48 target, 44pt on iOS, labelled FlareStrings close); disabled while not dismissible.

description.zh: 在起始处画返回键；此时 Escape 与平台返回键发出 back 而不是 close。宿主在默认插槽内切换页面。叫 showBack 而不是 Screen 的 back，是因为抽屉同时发出 back 事件。
description.en: Draw a leading back button; Escape and platform back then emit back instead of close. The host swaps its page inside the default slot. Named showBack (not Screen's back) because the drawer also emits back.

keyboardBehavior: Escape closes the drawer when dismissible, or emits back when showBack
Tab is trapped inside the drawer, including after an in-panel page change
Focus moves into the drawer on open and to its surface or heading when the page changes
Focus returns to the opener on close
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: The drawer appears and leaves without the slide; the scrim appears instantly.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Announce the title or label as the dialog name (aria-modal, isModal, paneTitle, scopesRoute); everything behind the scrim is inert while it is open.

notes.en: Long-lived secondary content beside the main view: on wide layouts a Drawer, on the phone form factor a page (the host's single-pane layout fact wins). The scrim is the token colors.scrim; the width is sizes.component.sheetWidth. Header row: [back?] title … [actions] [close?]; there is no header row when there is no title, no actions and showClose is false. A page pushed into the drawer that brings its own header with a way back (a Screen with back, such as PluginPage) declares it (Vue useFlareSheetOwnHeader and Compose FlareSheetOwnHeader(back); a FlareScreen with a back key declares it automatically on Vue, SwiftUI and Compose): the drawer then draws no header row (the title stays its accessible name), and Escape and the platform back go back one page in that page first; only when no page inside has a way back do they close the drawer, as the scrim always does. Vue renders it from `open` through the shared modal-surface stack and is full width on the phone form factor. Flutter presents it with `FlareDrawer.show<T>(context, title:, label:, placement:, width:, dismissible:, showClose:, navigable:, builder:)` — a nested Navigator on the root navigator, where the scrim closes the whole stack and Escape/back pop one page — and `FlareDrawer.showAdaptive<T>(context, asPage:, …)`, which pushes a page on the phone form factor and pushes inside an enclosing drawer. iOS presents `DrawerView` with `.flareDrawer(isPresented:|item:, …, navigable:, compactFallback: .none|.push)` (iOS 16.4+ full-screen cover with a clear background; a sheet on earlier iOS and on macOS). Compose composes `Drawer(onClose, …) { }` as a dialog window with a token scrim; hosts choose page or drawer with `flareCompactOverlays()`.
notes.zh: 放在主视图旁边的长驻次级内容：宽布局用 Drawer，手机形态用页面（宿主的单栏布局事实优先）。遮罩为 token colors.scrim，宽度为 sizes.component.sheetWidth。头部行：[返回?] 标题 … [actions] [关闭?]；没有标题、没有 actions 且 showClose 为 false 时不画头部行。推进抽屉、自带页头和返回的页面（带返回的 Screen，如 PluginPage）声明自带页头（Vue useFlareSheetOwnHeader、Compose FlareSheetOwnHeader(back)；Vue / SwiftUI / Compose 带返回键的 FlareScreen 自动声明）：抽屉不画头部行（标题只作可及名称），Escape 与平台返回先在那一页里退一页，里面没有能返回的页时才关抽屉；遮罩照旧关掉整个抽屉。Vue 由 `open` 经共用模态栈呈现，手机形态为全宽。Flutter 用 `FlareDrawer.show<T>(context, title:, label:, placement:, width:, dismissible:, showClose:, navigable:, builder:)` 呈现 —— 根导航器上的嵌套 Navigator，遮罩关闭整栈，Escape / 返回键逐页返回 —— 以及 `FlareDrawer.showAdaptive<T>(context, asPage:, …)`：手机形态推一页，已在抽屉内则在抽屉里推。iOS 用 `.flareDrawer(isPresented:|item:, …, navigable:, compactFallback: .none|.push)` 呈现 `DrawerView`（iOS 16.4+ 为透明背景的全屏覆盖；更早的 iOS 与 macOS 退为面板）。Compose 组合 `Drawer(onClose, …) { }`，它是带 token 遮罩的对话框窗口；宿主用 `flareCompactOverlays()` 在页面与抽屉之间选择。

summary.zh: 模态框 —— 遮罩上的居中面板，用于聚焦任务（全局搜索、较宽的编辑流程）；标题、头部 actions、底部按钮行、忙碌锁、高度上限与定高模式。
summary.en: Modal — a centered box over a scrim for focused tasks (global search, wider editing flows); title, header actions, a footer button row, a busy lock, a height cap and a fixed-height mode.

description.en: An operation owns the modal: every way of closing it is disabled until it finishes.

description.zh: 正文在高度上限内滚动；false 时给内容有界约束，由内容自己滚动（列表、搜索结果）。
description.en: The body scrolls inside the height cap; false hands the content bounded constraints and lets it own its scrolling (lists, search results).
