Tab is trapped inside the modal
Focus moves to the first control in the body on open, then the header controls
Focus returns to the opener on close
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: The modal appears without the scale animation; the scrim appears instantly.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Announce the title or label as the dialog name (aria-modal, isModal, paneTitle, scopesRoute); everything behind the scrim is inert while it is open.

notes.en: The centered form of the overlay family: BottomSheet's auto presentation hands its content here off the phone form factor, and global search uses it with `fill` on wide layouts (a page on the phone form factor). The scrim is the token colors.scrim; the width is sizes.component.sheetDialogWidth. The footer is the button row (trailing on wide, stacked full width on narrow); actions sit at the header's trailing edge. Vue renders it from `open` through the shared modal-surface stack. Flutter presents it with `FlareModal.show<T>(context, …, framed:, builder:)` (framed false for self-carded content); FlareModal replaces the former FlareDialog (its actions became footer, content became child, maxWidth became width, contentScrollable became scrollable, and FlareDialog.prompt became FlareBottomSheet.prompt). iOS presents `ModalView` with `.flareModal(isPresented:|item:, …)`. Compose composes `Modal(onClose, …) { }` as a dialog window with a token scrim.
notes.zh: 浮层家族里的居中形态：BottomSheet 的 auto 在非手机形态把内容交到这里，全局搜索在宽布局用它的 `fill`（手机形态为页面）。遮罩为 token colors.scrim，宽度为 sizes.component.sheetDialogWidth。footer 是按钮行（宽屏靠行尾，窄屏整宽堆叠）；actions 位于头部行尾。Vue 由 `open` 经共用模态栈呈现。Flutter 用 `FlareModal.show<T>(context, …, framed:, builder:)` 呈现（自带卡片的内容传 framed: false）；FlareModal 取代了原来的 FlareDialog（actions 改为 footer，content 改为 child，maxWidth 改为 width，contentScrollable 改为 scrollable，FlareDialog.prompt 改为 FlareBottomSheet.prompt）。iOS 用 `.flareModal(isPresented:|item:, …)` 呈现 `ModalView`。Compose 组合 `Modal(onClose, …) { }`，它是带 token 遮罩的对话框窗口。

summary.en: A small menu of actions: the new, more and context menus of an IM app, drawn from the shared action descriptor. Anchored to its trigger or the pointer on pointer devices and a bottom sheet on phones (Vue, Flutter); the system pull-down menu on iOS and the anchored dropdown on Android.
summary.zh: 一组操作的小菜单：IM 应用的新建、更多与右键菜单，按共享的操作描述绘制。指针设备上锚定在触发器或指针位置，手机上是底部面板（Vue、Flutter）；iOS 为系统下拉菜单，Android 为锚定下拉菜单。

dataSource.en: FlareActionItem[] built by the host or by a kit composite (row, header and message menus); the component reports the selected id.
dataSource.zh: 由宿主或组件库组合组件（会话行、头部、消息菜单）构造的 FlareActionItem[]；组件回报被选中的 id。

description.en: Actions in display order. Hidden ones are left out; a separator opens each new group; unavailable ones stay in place with their reason; pressed ones are checkable; danger ones use the error text colour.
description.zh: 按显示顺序排列的操作。隐藏的不画；分组变化处画分隔线；不可用的保留位置并显示原因；pressed 的是可勾选项；danger 的用错误文字色。

description.en: The menu's accessible name; also the sheet title on phones.
description.zh: 菜单的无障碍名称；在手机上也是面板标题。

description.en: Controlled open state (Compose `expanded`); leave it unset on Vue and the trigger opens and closes the menu.
description.zh: 受控的打开状态（Compose 为 `expanded`）；Vue 不传时由触发器开关菜单。

description.en: Anchor at a viewport point instead of the trigger (a context menu).
description.zh: 锚定到视口坐标而不是触发器（右键菜单）。

description.en: Anchor at a viewport point instead of the trigger (a context menu).
description.zh: 锚定到视口坐标而不是触发器（右键菜单）。

description.en: Where the anchored menu opens relative to its anchor.
description.zh: 锚定菜单相对锚点的打开位置。

description.en: auto: a bottom sheet on phone form factors (platform capability bottomSheet) and an anchored menu elsewhere.
description.zh: auto：手机形态（平台能力 bottomSheet）为底部面板，其它为锚定菜单。

description.en: click: the default slot's first element toggles the menu. manual: the slot is only the anchor and `open` decides.
description.zh: click：默认插槽的第一个元素开关菜单。manual：插槽只是锚点，由 `open` 决定。

keyboardBehavior: Enter or Space on the trigger opens the menu
Focus moves to the first available item
Arrow keys, Home and End move between items
Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger
Tab closes the menu
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: The menu appears without scale or fade.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: A named menu of menu items. The trigger exposes that it opens a menu and whether it is open; checkable items expose their checked state; unavailable items are announced as disabled with their reason.

notes.en: One item model on four kits: the shared action descriptor (`FlareActionItem`; Vue's generic base of composer and header actions). One grouping rule: host order is kept, a separator comes before an item whose group differs from the last group seen. Selecting an available item closes the menu, then reports its id. Vue renders its own ARIA menu (anchored through a popover, or a bottom sheet); Flutter the same through `FlareActionMenu(builder:)` or `FlareActionMenu.show(context, items:, label:, anchor:)`; iOS wraps the system `Menu` (`ActionMenuView`, fixed order, a check and the selected trait for pressed items); Compose a kit-styled dropdown placed in the trigger's Box (`ActionMenu(expanded, items, onDismiss, onSelect)`). The kit's own row, header and message menus are built on it.
notes.zh: 四端同一个条目模型：共享的操作描述（`FlareActionItem`；在 Vue 中是输入框操作与头部操作的泛型基类）。同一条分组规则：保持宿主顺序，条目的分组与上一个分组不同时在它之前画分隔线。选中可用条目会先关闭菜单再回报 id。Vue 自己渲染 ARIA 菜单（经弹出层锚定，或底部面板）；Flutter 通过 `FlareActionMenu(builder:)` 或 `FlareActionMenu.show(context, items:, label:, anchor:)` 同样实现；iOS 封装系统 `Menu`（`ActionMenuView`，固定顺序，pressed 条目带勾与 selected 特性）；Compose 为放在触发器 Box 里的组件库样式下拉菜单（`ActionMenu(expanded, items, onDismiss, onSelect)`）。组件库自己的会话行、头部与消息菜单都基于它。

summary.zh: 表单面板 —— 标题 + 字段插槽 + 确认 / 取消，busy 时锁定字段并禁止关闭；宿主提供字段、校验与持久化。
summary.en: Form sheet — title, field slot, confirm / cancel; busy locks the fields and dismissal; the host supplies fields, validation and persistence.

dataSource.zh: 由你传入
dataSource.en: passed in by you

description.zh: 是否打开（受控）。
description.en: Whether the sheet is open (controlled).

description.zh: 标题。
description.en: Title.

description.zh: 提交中：字段禁用、不可关闭、确认按钮 loading。
description.en: Submitting: fields disabled, dismissal blocked, confirm shows loading.

description.zh: 确认按钮不可用（校验未过）。
description.en: Confirm disabled (validation failed).

description.zh: 确认按钮可用（校验通过）。
description.en: Confirm enabled (validation passed).

description.zh: 确认文案；Vue 缺省取字符串表。
description.en: Confirm label; Vue defaults to the strings table.

description.zh: 取消文案；Vue 缺省取字符串表。
description.en: Cancel label; Vue defaults to the strings table.

description.zh: 表单级错误文案。
description.en: Form-level error text.

description.zh: 与 BottomSheet 相同：手机形态为底部面板，其它形态交给 Modal 居中呈现；sheet 总是底部面板。
description.en: Same as BottomSheet: a bottom sheet on the phone form factor, otherwise handed to Modal as a centered box; sheet is always a bottom sheet.

description.zh: 交给 Modal 呈现时的宽度（转给 BottomSheet 的 dialogWidth）。组件根是 Teleport，宿主的 class 与自定义属性到不了被传送出去的面上。
description.en: Width when the form is handed to Modal (forwarded as BottomSheet's dialogWidth). The component's root is a Teleport, so a host class or custom property never reaches the teleported surface.

keyboardBehavior: Escape closes the sheet unless busy
Enter inside a field submits (confirm)
Tab cycles the fields, cancel and confirm
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: The sheet appears without slide animation; the busy state uses a static indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Announce the title as the dialog name, the busy state via aria-busy, the form-level error as an alert, and the confirm availability.

notes.en: FormSheet is hosted in BottomSheet with `presentation="auto"` on every platform: a bottom sheet on the phone form factor, Modal otherwise. Vue FlareFormSheet passes `presentation` through; iOS FormSheetView sizes itself to the kit sheet when presented with `flareBottomSheet` (auto) and locks dismissal through `FlareLayerDismissDisabledKey` while busy; Compose FormDialog hosts itself in `BottomSheet(presentation = FlareSheetPresentation.Auto)`; Flutter hosts compose the same form inside `FlareBottomSheet.show` (auto) or use `FlareBottomSheet.prompt`.
notes.zh: FormSheet 在各端都由 `presentation="auto"` 的 BottomSheet 承载：手机形态为底部面板，其它形态为 Modal。Vue FlareFormSheet 透传 `presentation`；iOS FormSheetView 经 `flareBottomSheet`（auto）呈现时适配组件库面板尺寸，忙碌时通过 `FlareLayerDismissDisabledKey` 锁住关闭；Compose FormDialog 把自己放进 `BottomSheet(presentation = FlareSheetPresentation.Auto)`；Flutter 宿主在 `FlareBottomSheet.show`（auto）中组合同样的表单，或直接用 `FlareBottomSheet.prompt`。

summary.zh: 单条设置行 —— FlareSettingsItem 的唯一渲染：图标、标签、明细、开关或 chevron，danger / disabled 语义；SettingsList 由它组成。
summary.en: One settings row — the single rendering of a FlareSettingsItem: icon, label, detail, toggle or chevron, danger / disabled semantics; SettingsList is built from it.

dataSource.zh: 宿主提供的 FlareSettingsItem
dataSource.en: a host-supplied FlareSettingsItem

description.zh: 要渲染的设置项（key / label / kind: navigation | toggle | action | value / detail / danger / disabled）。value 行只读，不渲染按钮。
description.en: The item to render (key / label / kind: navigation | toggle | action | value / detail / danger / disabled). A value row is read-only and renders no button.

keyboardBehavior: Enter / Space activates the row (flips a toggle or selects)
Tab moves to the next row
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Remove non-essential motion; the toggle changes state without animation.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Expose the label, the detail, the toggle state (switch) or the navigation affordance (button), and disabled / danger availability.

notes.en: toggle carries (item, value), select carries item; identical on all four platforms.
notes.zh: toggle 带 (item, value)，select 带 item；四端一致。

summary.zh: 品牌 Logo —— 前倾几何 F（skewX -9°），gradient（品牌渐变底 + 白 F）或 plate（白底 + 渐变 F）两种变体；四端共用同一几何。
summary.en: Brand logo — the forward-leaning geometric F (skewX -9°) in two variants, gradient (brand gradient plate + white F) or plate (white plate + gradient F); one geometry on all four platforms.

dataSource.zh: 无数据
dataSource.en: no data

description.zh: 边长（逻辑像素）。
description.en: Side length in logical pixels.

description.zh: gradient 用于中性 / 浅底与 app 图标；plate 用于品牌色背景（如登录头）。
description.en: gradient for neutral / light grounds and app icons; plate on brand-colored grounds (e.g. the auth header).

keyboardBehavior: Not focusable
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: Static artwork; no motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: An image named "flare IM"; decorative when placed next to the brand wordmark (host hides it).

notes.en: Decorative brand artwork; hosts compose it into auth screens, splash and about pages. Colors follow the active brand theme.
notes.zh: 装饰性的品牌图形；宿主把它组合进登录页、启动页与关于页。颜色跟随当前品牌主题。

summary.en: Metric tile — the one number a dashboard leads with: what is measured, its value, and optionally the change since the last period and a line of context.
summary.zh: 指标卡 —— 仪表盘领头的那个数字：度量什么、当前值，可选与上期相比的变化和一行说明。

dataSource.en: host-owned reading — a number (formatted in the kit's language), a preformatted string, or `null` for no data; the host decides whether a rise is good news (`polarity`)
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有的读数 —— 数字（按组件库语言格式化）、已格式化的字符串，或表示无数据的 `null`；上升算好消息还是坏消息由宿主决定（`polarity`）

description.en: What is measured. Names the tile for assistive technology.
description.zh: 度量的名称；也是辅助技术读到的分组名。

description.en: The reading. A number is formatted per locale; a string is shown as it is; `null` draws a dash that is read as "No data", never a 0.
description.zh: 读数。数字按语言格式化；字符串原样显示；`null` 画一条横线，读屏读作「暂无数据」，绝不显示成 0。

description.en: Unit after the value: a lone symbol such as % sits on the number, a word takes a space.
description.zh: 数值后的单位：% 这类单个符号紧贴数字，词语单位前留一个空格。

description.en: One line of context under the value — the period, the quota, a collection time.
description.zh: 数值下的一行说明 —— 统计周期、配额、采集时间。

description.en: Change since the previous period, drawn signed with a direction mark and read as "up 12" / "down 3" / "unchanged".
description.zh: 与上期相比的变化，带正负号和方向标记；读屏读作「增加 12」/「减少 3」/「持平」。

description.en: Unit after the change, e.g. % for a relative change.
description.zh: 变化量的单位，例如相对变化用 %。

description.en: Which direction is good news: colours the change green or red. `neutral` reports it without judging.
description.zh: 哪个方向是好消息：据此把变化染成成功色或错误色。`neutral` 只陈述不评判。

description.en: Abbreviate large numbers (1.2万 / 12K).
description.zh: 大数缩写（1.2万 / 12K）。

description.en: Draw a placeholder of the value's size (aria-busy) while the host fetches it.
description.zh: 宿主取数期间画一个与数值同高的占位（aria-busy）。

description.en: `card` draws its own surface; `plain` sits inside a surface the host already drew.
description.zh: `card` 自带卡片面；`plain` 放在宿主已画好的面里。

description.en: BCP-47 tag for the digits. Default: the kit's language.
description.zh: 数字所用的 BCP-47 语言标签。默认跟随组件库语言。

notes.en: Place tiles in a grid; one tile per number. Vue only: native N/A. It is a dashboard component for web consoles (the admin console's tenant and workspace overviews); no Flutter, SwiftUI or Compose app ships an analytics dashboard, and a native widget nobody renders would only drift from this one. Add the native kits when a native screen needs it, with the same contract.
notes.zh: 多个指标卡放进网格，一个数字一张。仅 Vue，原生端 N/A：这是给 Web 控制台用的仪表盘组件（管理控制台的租户与工作区概览）；Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 端没有任何 App 提供数据看板，一个无人渲染的原生控件只会和这里渐行渐远。等原生界面真正需要时再按同一契约实现。

accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: No motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: A group named by the label. The value is read as text with its unit; no data is read as "No data" (the dash is hidden); the change is read as "up 12%" / "down 3%" / "unchanged" (the signed number and the caret are hidden); while loading the group is aria-busy and reads "Loading".

summary.en: Chart card — one series over time as bars or a line, in a titled card. Plain SVG drawn from kit tokens, with every reading also available as text.
summary.zh: 图表卡片 —— 一条随时间变化的序列，画成柱状图或折线图，放在带标题的卡片里。纯 SVG、只用组件库 token 绘制，每个读数同时以文字提供。

dataSource.en: host-owned series of `{ label, value }` points in display order (`value: null` is a gap, not a zero); the host formats the labels (dates, periods)
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有的 `{ label, value }` 序列，按显示顺序（`value: null` 表示缺数据，不是 0）；日期、周期等标签由宿主格式化

description.en: Card heading; also names the plot for assistive technology.
description.zh: 卡片标题；也用于给图表命名。

description.en: The series in order. `value: null` is a label with no reading: no bar, a break in the line.
description.zh: 按顺序排列的序列。`value: null` 表示该标签没有读数：不画柱，折线在此断开。

description.en: `bar` for counts per period, `line` for a level over time.
description.zh: `bar` 表示每个周期的计数，`line` 表示随时间变化的水平。

description.en: Colour of the series; `brand` is the theme's primary colour.
description.zh: 序列颜色；`brand` 是主题主色。

description.en: One line under the title — the period, the source.
description.zh: 标题下的一行说明 —— 统计周期、数据来源。

description.en: Unit of the readings, used in the summary, the table and on hover; a lone symbol such as % also marks the scale.
description.zh: 读数单位，用于摘要、数据表和悬停提示；% 这类单个符号也标在刻度上。

description.en: Shown when there is no reading to draw. Default: the kit's "No data yet".
description.zh: 没有可画的读数时显示。默认用组件库的「暂无数据」。

description.en: Draw a placeholder of the plot's size (aria-busy) while the host fetches the series.
description.zh: 宿主取数期间画一个与图表同尺寸的占位（aria-busy）。

description.en: `card` draws its own surface; `plain` sits inside a surface the host already drew.
description.zh: `card` 自带卡片面；`plain` 放在宿主已画好的面里。

description.en: BCP-47 tag for the digits. Default: the kit's language.
description.zh: 数字所用的 BCP-47 语言标签。默认跟随组件库语言。

notes.en: No readings draw the empty text instead of an empty axis; one reading is one bar or one dot; a series of zeros draws the zero line alone. The plot's height is the `--flare-chart-card-plot-height` custom property on the card. `extra` holds the host's controls (period switch, export), `footer` a note under the plot (collection time). Vue only: native N/A. It is a dashboard component for web consoles (the admin console's tenant and workspace overviews); no Flutter, SwiftUI or Compose app ships an analytics dashboard, and a native widget nobody renders would only drift from this one. Add the native kits when a native screen needs it, with the same contract.
notes.zh: 没有读数时显示空态文案而不是一条空坐标轴；只有一个读数就是一根柱或一个点；全为 0 时只画零线。图表高度由卡片上的 `--flare-chart-card-plot-height` 自定义属性决定。`extra` 放宿主的控件（周期切换、导出），`footer` 放图下的说明（采集时间）。仅 Vue，原生端 N/A：这是给 Web 控制台用的仪表盘组件（管理控制台的租户与工作区概览）；Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 端没有任何 App 提供数据看板，一个无人渲染的原生控件只会和这里渐行渐远。等原生界面真正需要时再按同一契约实现。

accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: No motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: The card is a region named by its title. The plot is role=img named by a numeric summary — how many points, the first and last label, the lowest, highest and latest reading with the unit — and every reading is also in a visually hidden table (label, value; a gap reads "no data"). The scale and the axis labels are hidden from assistive technology; while loading the card is aria-busy and reads "Loading"; with no readings it is the empty text.

summary.en: Data table — host-owned rows in a real table, with sorting the host performs, server-side pagination, a tri-state selection that spans pages and raises a batch toolbar, and a column chooser whose choice the host keeps.
summary.zh: 数据表格 —— 宿主持有的行放进真正的表格：排序由宿主执行、服务端分页、跨页的三态多选并带出批量工具条、列设置由宿主持久化。

dataSource.en: host-owned `rows` of this page (already sorted and paged), `columns`, the current `sort` and `pagination`; the table emits the next sort / page / page size and never reorders rows itself
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有的本页 `rows`（已排好序、已分页）、`columns`、当前 `sort` 与 `pagination`；表格只上报下一个排序 / 页码 / 每页条数，自己从不重排行

description.en: Columns in display order.
description.zh: 按显示顺序排列的列。

description.en: The rows of this page, already sorted and paged by the host.
description.zh: 本页的行，由宿主排好序并分好页。

description.en: Field that identifies a row, or a function of the row.
description.zh: 标识一行的字段，或由行计算 key 的函数。

description.en: Accessible name of the table. Default: the kit's "Table".
description.zh: 表格的可及名称。默认用组件库的「数据表格」。

description.en: Draw placeholder rows (aria-busy) while the host fetches the page.
description.zh: 宿主取数期间画占位行（aria-busy）。

description.en: Shown when there are no rows. Default: the kit's "No data yet".
description.zh: 没有行时显示。默认用组件库的「暂无数据」。

description.en: Server-side pagination; the table emits the next page or page size and the host fetches. Without `total` it pages by cursor: the page number alone, and `hasNext` enables the next key.
description.zh: 服务端分页；表格上报下一页或每页条数，由宿主取数。不传 `total` 即游标分页：只显示页码，由 `hasNext` 决定下一页键是否可用。

description.en: The current sort; a sortable header cycles ascending, descending, then the host's order, and the host sorts.
description.zh: 当前排序；可排序表头依次升序、降序、回到宿主默认顺序，排序由宿主执行。

description.en: A checkbox per row and a tri-state one in the header; a non-empty selection shows the batch toolbar.
description.zh: 每行一个复选框，表头一个三态复选框；选中不为空时显示批量工具条。

description.en: Keys of the selected rows, across pages (v-model).
description.zh: 选中行的 key，跨页保留（v-model）。

description.en: A control that shows or hides columns; a popover on pointer devices, a sheet on phones.
description.zh: 显示 / 隐藏列的控件；指针设备上是浮层，手机上是底部面板。

description.en: Keys of the columns the chooser shows; `null` shows every column. The host persists it (v-model). The last visible column and a column with `hideable: false` cannot be hidden.
description.zh: 列设置里可见列的 key；`null` 表示全部可见。由宿主持久化（v-model）。最后一列与 `hideable: false` 的列不能隐藏。

description.en: Pin the header inside the table's own scroll box, whose height is `--flare-component-data-table-max-height`.
description.zh: 把表头钉在表格自己的滚动盒里，盒高由 `--flare-component-data-table-max-height` 决定。

description.en: Row height: `comfortable` for reading, `compact` for scanning. Touch targets do not shrink.
description.zh: 行高：`comfortable` 便于阅读，`compact` 便于扫视。触控区不缩小。

notes.en: Cells render through `cell-<key>` scoped slots (`{ row, value, index, column }`), or the slot a column names; `row-actions` adds a trailing actions column (`{ row, index }`); `batch` renders inside the batch toolbar with `{ selectedKeys, selectedRows, clear }`; `toolbar` is the leading area of the bar above the table, beside the column chooser; `empty` replaces the empty state. A source that pages by cursor and cannot count (`has_more` / `next_cursor`) omits `total`: the pager shows the rows of this page and the page number, previous / next move one page at a time, next follows `hasNext`, and the host keeps the cursor of each page it visited; the table's row count is then -1 (unknown). A non-empty selection is a contextual layer: Escape, the platform back and the kit's back controls clear it. On a container narrower than 600px rows stack into labelled lines, the header stays for assistive technology and sorting moves into a menu in the bar; every table element carries its explicit role because the stacked form changes `display`. Vue only: native N/A. It is a console component (the admin console's lists of users, apps, audit events); no Flutter, SwiftUI or Compose app ships an admin console, and a native widget nobody renders would only drift from this one. Add the native kits when a native screen needs it, with the same contract.
notes.zh: 单元格通过 `cell-<key>` 作用域插槽渲染（`{ row, value, index, column }`），或列指定的插槽；`row-actions` 在末尾加一列操作（`{ row, index }`）；`batch` 渲染在批量工具条里，拿到 `{ selectedKeys, selectedRows, clear }`；`toolbar` 是表格上方那条栏的前部，与列设置并排；`empty` 替换空态。游标分页、无法计数的数据源（`has_more` / `next_cursor`）不传 `total`：分页器显示本页行号与页码，上一页 / 下一页每次移动一页，下一页跟随 `hasNext`，宿主记住访问过的每页游标；此时表格的总行数为 -1（未知）。选中不为空就是一个上下文层：Escape、平台返回与组件库的返回控件都会清空它。容器窄于 600px 时行堆叠成带标签的行，表头留给辅助技术，排序移到栏里的菜单；堆叠会改变 `display`，所以每个表格元素都显式带 role。仅 Vue，原生端 N/A：这是控制台组件（管理控制台的用户、应用、审计列表）；Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 端没有任何 App 提供管理控制台，一个无人渲染的原生控件只会和这里渐行渐远。等原生界面真正需要时再按同一契约实现。

keyboardBehavior: Tab visits the sort buttons, the checkboxes, the row actions and the pager in reading order
Enter or Space on a sortable header cycles its sort
Enter or Space on a row activates it when the host listens for rowClick
Escape clears a non-empty selection (the batch toolbar is a contextual layer)
Escape closes the column chooser and returns focus to its trigger
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: The sort glyph appears without a fade; nothing else moves.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: A named table with explicit table, rowgroup, row, columnheader and cell roles (kept when a narrow container stacks the rows). Sortable headers carry aria-sort; the header checkbox reads mixed when some rows of the page are selected; each row checkbox is named by its row number and each selected row is aria-selected. The batch toolbar is a named toolbar whose count is a polite live region. Loading is aria-busy with a status; the empty state is text. The pager is a named navigation with a named page-size combobox and previous / next buttons; a cursor-paged table reports aria-rowcount -1 because the total is unknown.

summary.en: Permission tree — a tree of permission codes with tri-state checks: a leaf is a code, a parent reads as checked, mixed or clear from its leaves. Searchable, foldable, keyboard-walkable.
summary.zh: 权限树 —— 带三态勾选的权限码树：叶子是权限码，父节点由叶子推出全选、半选或未选。可搜索、可折叠、可用键盘遍历。

dataSource.en: host-owned `nodes` (`{ code, name, description?, children? }`) and the leaf codes that are checked (`checkedCodes`); parents are derived and never stored
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有的 `nodes`（`{ code, name, description?, children? }`）与已勾选的叶子权限码（`checkedCodes`）；父节点只推导、从不存储

description.en: The permission catalogue, nested.
description.zh: 嵌套的权限目录。

description.en: Leaf codes that are checked (v-model). A parent toggle checks or clears every enabled leaf below it.
description.zh: 已勾选的叶子权限码（v-model）。切换父节点会勾选或清空其下所有未禁用的叶子。

description.en: Accessible name of the tree. Default: the kit's "Permissions".
description.zh: 树的可及名称。默认用组件库的「权限」。

description.en: Show the state with a view-only hint and ignore every toggle.
description.zh: 只显示状态并提示仅可查看，忽略所有切换。

description.en: Leaf codes that cannot be changed; a parent toggle leaves them as they are.
description.zh: 不可更改的叶子权限码；切换父节点时保持原样。

description.en: Draw the search field above the tree: a match is kept with its ancestors (forced open) and its descendants.
description.zh: 在树上方画搜索框：匹配项连同祖先（强制展开）和后代一起保留。

description.en: Placeholder of the search field. Default: the kit's "Search permissions".
description.zh: 搜索框的占位文字。默认用组件库的「搜索权限」。

description.en: Start with every group open.
description.zh: 初始时展开所有分组。

description.en: Shown when the search matches nothing. Default: the kit's "No matching permissions".
description.zh: 搜索无结果时显示。默认用组件库的「没有匹配的权限」。

notes.en: `node` renders an item's content with `{ node, depth, state, expanded, matched, disabled }`; `empty` replaces the no-match state. The tree is flattened once and every derived answer (states, matches, rows on screen) is one pass over the flat list, so a thousand nodes stay smooth. The row height is `--flare-component-permission-tree-row-height`. Vue only: native N/A. It is a console component (role editing in the admin console); no Flutter, SwiftUI or Compose app edits roles, and a native widget nobody renders would only drift from this one. Add the native kits when a native screen needs it, with the same contract.
notes.zh: `node` 用 `{ node, depth, state, expanded, matched, disabled }` 渲染一项的内容；`empty` 替换无结果状态。树只拍平一次，每个派生结果（状态、匹配、屏上行）都是对扁平列表的一次遍历，一千个节点仍然流畅。行高是 `--flare-component-permission-tree-row-height`。仅 Vue，原生端 N/A：这是控制台组件（管理控制台的角色权限编辑）；Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 端没有任何 App 编辑角色，一个无人渲染的原生控件只会和这里渐行渐远。等原生界面真正需要时再按同一契约实现。

keyboardBehavior: Tab reaches one item (roving tabindex); Arrow Down and Arrow Up move between visible items
Arrow Right opens a group, then moves to its first child; Arrow Left closes a group or moves to the parent
Home and End move to the first and last visible item
Space or Enter toggles the item (checked, or every enabled leaf of a group)
Typing in the search field filters the tree; matches keep their ancestors open
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: The check mark fills without a transition; nothing else moves.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: A named tree of tree items with aria-level, aria-posinset and aria-setsize; a group exposes aria-expanded; every item exposes aria-checked true / false / mixed derived from its leaves, and a disabled item aria-disabled. The item itself is the one control, so the check box beside the name is decorative. The selected count is a polite live region; read-only draws a view-only hint; no match is the empty text.

summary.en: Filter bar — the query form above a console list: labelled fields in a grid that wraps by its own width, Search and Reset keys, and less used fields folded behind "More filters".
summary.zh: 查询条件栏 —— 控制台列表上方的查询表单：带标签的字段放进按自身宽度换行的网格，查询与重置键，不常用的字段收进「更多条件」。

dataSource.en: host-owned field values (each field a FormField around a kit control in the default and `more` slots); the bar only reports `search` and `reset` and never reads or clears a value itself
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有的字段值（每个字段是放进默认插槽与 `more` 插槽的 FormField + 组件库控件）；查询栏只上报 `search` 与 `reset`，自己从不读取或清空字段值

description.en: Accessible name of the search region. Default: the kit's "Filters".
description.zh: 查询区域的可及名称。默认用组件库的「查询条件」。

description.en: A line above the fields — what the query needs, what it searches; it also describes the region.
description.zh: 字段上方的一行说明 —— 查询需要什么、查的是什么；同时作为区域的描述。

description.en: The host is running the query: the Search key shows progress and Enter does not queue a second one.
description.zh: 宿主正在查询：查询键显示进度，回车不会再排一次查询。

description.en: Search key text. Default: the kit's "Search".
description.zh: 查询键文字。默认用组件库的「查询」。

description.en: Reset key text. Default: the kit's "Reset".
description.zh: 重置键文字。默认用组件库的「重置」。

description.en: Draw the Reset key.
description.zh: 是否画重置键。

description.en: How many folded fields hold a value; shown on the "More filters" key while they are folded, so a hidden condition is never a surprise.
description.zh: 收起的字段里有几项已填值；收起时显示在「更多条件」键上，被收起的条件不会让人意外。

description.en: Whether the `more` fields are shown (v-model).
description.zh: 是否展开 `more` 字段（v-model）。

notes.en: Put one FormField per condition in the default slot and the rarely used ones in `more`; `actions` takes host keys (export, create) after Search, Reset and the disclosure. Enter in a one-line text field reports `search`; a control that acts on its own Enter keeps it (a handled key, an open combobox, an IME composition, a textarea, a button). The region is a `search` landmark, not a `<form>`, so a host button in `actions` never submits by accident. The keys take the last two cells of the last grid row, or the whole row on a one-column grid; the minimum field width is `--flare-component-filter-bar-field-min-width`. Vue only: native N/A. It is a console component (the query bar of every admin list); no Flutter, SwiftUI or Compose app ships an admin console, and a native widget nobody renders would only drift from this one. Add the native kits when a native screen needs it, with the same contract.
notes.zh: 每个条件一个 FormField 放进默认插槽，不常用的放进 `more`；`actions` 放宿主的键（导出、新建），排在查询、重置与展开键之后。单行文本框里按回车上报 `search`；自己处理回车的控件保留它（已处理的按键、展开中的组合框、输入法组字、多行文本框、按钮）。区域是 `search` 地标而不是 `<form>`，所以 `actions` 里宿主的按钮不会误提交。按键占网格最后一行的最后两格，单列网格时占满整行；字段最小宽度是 `--flare-component-filter-bar-field-min-width`。仅 Vue，原生端 N/A：这是控制台组件（每个管理列表上方的查询栏）；Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 端没有任何 App 提供管理控制台，一个无人渲染的原生控件只会和这里渐行渐远。等原生界面真正需要时再按同一契约实现。

keyboardBehavior: Tab visits the fields, then Search, Reset, the More filters disclosure and the host's keys
Enter in a one-line text field searches; a control that handles its own Enter keeps it
Enter or Space on the disclosure shows or hides the folded fields; focus stays on it
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: The folded fields appear and leave without a transition.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: A named search landmark described by its hint. Each field is a labelled FormField. The disclosure exposes aria-expanded and, while open, aria-controls on the folded fields; its name says how many folded fields hold a value. The Search key is aria-busy while the host runs the query.

summary.en: Schema form — fields drawn from a JSON Schema object: an enum of strings as a select, integer as a whole-number input within minimum and maximum, boolean as a switch, string as a text input; title labels a field, description explains it.
summary.zh: Schema 表单 —— 按 JSON Schema 对象画字段：字符串枚举画成下拉，integer 画成在 minimum 与 maximum 之间的整数输入，boolean 画成开关，string 画成文本框；title 作字段标签，description 作说明。

dataSource.en: a JSON Schema the host passes (a plugin's settings schema) and the host-owned values (v-model)
dataSource.zh: 宿主传入的 JSON Schema（插件的配置 schema）与宿主持有的值（v-model）

description.en: A JSON Schema object. Its first 32 `properties` of type string, integer or boolean become fields, in order; a property may `$ref` a `#/$defs/` entry. Anything else is skipped, never evaluated.
description.zh: JSON Schema 对象。`properties` 中前 32 个 string、integer、boolean 类型的属性按顺序画成字段；属性可以 `$ref` 到 `#/$defs/` 条目。其余一律跳过，从不求值。

description.en: The values by property name (v-model). Every edit emits a new object; the form never mutates the one passed in.
description.zh: 按属性名的取值（v-model）。每次修改发出一个新对象；表单从不改动传入的对象。

description.en: Lock every field.
description.zh: 锁定所有字段。

keyboardBehavior: Tab visits the fields in schema order
Each field keeps its control's own keys (arrows in the select and the number input, Space on the switch)
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: No motion beyond the kit controls.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Each field is named by its title (the property name when it has none); the description is the field's feedback line.

notes.en: Vue only: native N/A. It renders a plugin's raw settings schema on a web console page; native apps draw plugin inputs the core SDK has already resolved with PluginForm. An enum longer than 100 values, a non-integer bound and every other type are skipped; strings are capped at 4096 characters.
notes.zh: 仅 Vue，原生端 N/A：它在 Web 控制台页面上渲染插件的原始配置 schema；原生 App 用 PluginForm 渲染核心 SDK 解析好的插件输入。超过 100 项的枚举、非整数边界与其他类型一律跳过；字符串最长 4096 个字符。

summary.en: Description list — the facts of one record as label / value lines in a real `<dl>`, laid out in columns by its own width, with "not set" for an empty value and a copy key on identifiers.
summary.zh: 描述列表 —— 一条记录的各项事实，以「标签 / 值」行放进真正的 `<dl>`，按自身宽度分栏；空值显示「未设置」，标识符带复制键。

dataSource.en: host-owned `items` (key, label, value already formatted, span, monospace, copyable); a value the host leaves `null`, `undefined` or empty is drawn as not set, and an `item-<key>` slot renders a line the host draws itself
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有的 `items`（key、label、已格式化的 value、span、monospace、copyable）；宿主留空（`null`、`undefined` 或空串）的值画成「未设置」，`item-<key>` 插槽让宿主自己画某一行

description.en: The lines, in reading order.
description.zh: 各行，按阅读顺序。

description.en: Columns on a wide container (1–4). Under 480px of its own width the list is one column.
description.zh: 宽容器下的列数（1–4）。自身宽度不足 480px 时为单列。

description.en: `start` puts each label beside its value; `top` puts it above.
description.zh: `start` 标签在值的旁边；`top` 标签在值的上方。

description.en: Names the list as a group, when a page holds more than one.
description.zh: 页面上有多个列表时，作为分组名称。

description.en: `plain` sits inside a surface the host already drew; `card` draws its own.
description.zh: `plain` 放在宿主已画好的面里；`card` 自带卡片面。

notes.en: Lines render through `item-<key>` scoped slots (`{ item, value }`) when the value is more than text — a Tag, a link, an avatar. A copy key writes the value's text and reports `copy(key, copied)`; the host shows the toast. An empty value is a dash that a screen reader reads as "Not set", never a blank or "null"; zero is a value. Vue only: native N/A. It is a console component (detail drawers for users, applications, messages and audit events); no Flutter, SwiftUI or Compose app ships an admin console, and a native widget nobody renders would only drift from this one. Add the native kits when a native screen needs it, with the same contract.
notes.zh: 某一行不只是文字时（标签、链接、头像）用 `item-<key>` 作用域插槽（`{ item, value }`）渲染。复制键写入该值的文字并上报 `copy(key, copied)`，提示由宿主给。空值是一条横线，读屏读作「未设置」，绝不是空白或「null」；0 是值。仅 Vue，原生端 N/A：这是控制台组件（用户、应用、消息与审计事件的详情抽屉）；Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 端没有任何 App 提供管理控制台，一个无人渲染的原生控件只会和这里渐行渐远。等原生界面真正需要时再按同一契约实现。

keyboardBehavior: Tab reaches each copy key; Enter or Space copies the value
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: No motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: A description list: each line is a term (the label) and its definition (the value). With `label` the list is a named group. An empty value reads "Not set" (the dash is hidden). Each copy key is named "Copy <label>".

summary.en: Code block — text a person reads exactly and usually copies (a raw payload, an initialisation snippet) in a monospaced, bounded scroll box with a copy key.
summary.zh: 代码块 —— 需要逐字阅读、通常还要复制的文本（原始报文、初始化代码），放在等宽、限高的滚动框里，带复制键。

dataSource.en: host-owned `code`, already formatted (`JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)` for a payload) and already reduced to what may be shown; `language` is only the label over it
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有的 `code`，已格式化（报文用 `JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)`）且已裁剪到可以展示的内容；`language` 只是上方的标签

description.en: The text, exactly as it should be read and copied.
description.zh: 要逐字阅读与复制的文本。

description.en: What the text is (JSON, TypeScript, curl), shown over it. Nothing is highlighted.
description.zh: 文本是什么（JSON、TypeScript、curl），显示在上方。不做语法高亮。

description.en: Accessible name of the scroll box. Default: `language`, else the kit's "Code".
description.zh: 滚动框的可及名称。默认用 `language`，否则用组件库的「代码」。

description.en: Draw the copy key; it reports `copy(copied)`.
description.zh: 是否画复制键；复制后上报 `copy(copied)`。

description.en: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways.
description.zh: 长行折行，而不是横向滚动。

description.en: Height cap as a CSS length. Default `--flare-component-code-block-max-height`.
description.zh: 高度上限（CSS 长度）。默认 `--flare-component-code-block-max-height`。

notes.en: No syntax highlighting: a console shows a payload to read and copy, and a highlighter is a parser per language plus a palette per theme the kit would have to keep at 4.5:1 in every brand. The scroll box is a named, focusable region, so a keyboard can scroll it. The host decides what may be shown (no secrets in a payload view). Vue only: native N/A. It is a console component (raw message payloads, webhook bodies, the quick-start snippet); no Flutter, SwiftUI or Compose app ships an admin console, and a native widget nobody renders would only drift from this one. Add the native kits when a native screen needs it, with the same contract.
notes.zh: 不做语法高亮：控制台展示报文是为了阅读与复制，而高亮器意味着每种语言一个解析器、每个主题一套配色，组件库还得保证每个品牌都 4.5:1。滚动框是有名称、可聚焦的区域，键盘可以滚动它。能展示什么由宿主决定（报文视图里不放密钥）。仅 Vue，原生端 N/A：这是控制台组件（原始消息报文、Webhook 请求体、快速开始代码）；Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 端没有任何 App 提供管理控制台，一个无人渲染的原生控件只会和这里渐行渐远。等原生界面真正需要时再按同一契约实现。

keyboardBehavior: Tab reaches the copy key, then the scroll box; arrow keys scroll the box
Enter or Space on the copy key copies the whole text
accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: No motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: The text is in a named, focusable region (role region) so a screen reader and a keyboard both reach it; the copy key is named "Copy code" and is disabled when there is nothing to copy. The language label is plain text.

summary.en: Tag — a short status or category label on a table row or a detail line, coloured by a semantic tone that only repeats what the words say.
summary.zh: 标签 —— 表格行或详情行上一个简短的状态或类别标签，语义色调只是重复文字已经表达的含义。

dataSource.en: host-owned `label` (already translated) and the `tone` the host maps its state to
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有的 `label`（已翻译）与宿主为该状态选定的 `tone`

description.en: The words: a state or a category, not a sentence.
description.zh: 文字：一个状态或类别，不是一句话。

description.en: What the state means: `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, or `neutral` for a category with no judgement.
description.zh: 状态的含义：`info`、`success`、`warning`、`danger`，或无评判的类别 `neutral`。

description.en: A leading dot for a live state (online, running) rather than a category.
description.zh: 前置圆点，用于实时状态（在线、运行中）而不是类别。

description.en: Draw the label in the monospaced face — an identifier, a code, a version.
description.zh: 用等宽字体显示 —— 标识符、代码、版本号。

notes.en: Not a control: no hover, no focus, no click (a filter a person toggles is FilterTabs, an action is a Button). Each tone writes its text colour on a 6% tint of the tone over the primary surface, which keeps 4.5:1 in every brand and both modes as painted (lowest 4.64:1); at 8% the light warning tag paints at 4.49:1. Vue only: native N/A. It is a console component (status and kind labels in console tables and detail drawers); no Flutter, SwiftUI or Compose app ships an admin console, and a native widget nobody renders would only drift from this one. Add the native kits when a native screen needs it, with the same contract.
notes.zh: 不是控件：没有悬停、焦点与点击（可切换的筛选是 FilterTabs，动作是 Button）。每种色调把文字色写在该色调 6% 叠加主背景的底上，按实际绘制的颜色各品牌明暗两种模式都保持 4.5:1（最低 4.64:1）；用 8% 时浅色警告标签实绘只有 4.49:1。仅 Vue，原生端 N/A：这是控制台组件（控制台表格与详情抽屉里的状态与类型标签）；Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 端没有任何 App 提供管理控制台，一个无人渲染的原生控件只会和这里渐行渐远。等原生界面真正需要时再按同一契约实现。

accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: No motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Plain text: a screen reader reads the label; the tone colour and the dot are not announced, so the label carries the meaning on its own.

summary.en: User identity — one person in a console table cell or detail line: avatar, full nickname and one account name, with loading and unavailable states that never fall back to an internal ID.
summary.zh: 用户身份 —— 控制台表格单元格或详情行里的一个人：头像、完整昵称和一个账号，加载中与不可用状态绝不回落成内部 ID。

dataSource.en: host-owned `user` summary (`UserIdentityValue`): a nickname, one account and an avatar URL already projected by the host; the component reads no service, role or tenant state
dataSource.zh: 宿主持有的 `user` 摘要（`UserIdentityValue`）：宿主已投影好的昵称、一个账号和头像地址；组件不读取服务、角色或租户状态

description.en: The person to show. `state` `loading` or `unavailable` replaces the name and account with a label and the avatar with a neutral one (never the label's first character, never the avatar image); stale details are never shown.
description.zh: 要展示的人。`state` 为 `loading` 或 `unavailable` 时昵称与账号换成提示文字，头像换成中性头像（不取提示文字的首字，也不显示头像图片）；不显示旧资料。

notes.en: Not a control: no hover, focus or click. Name and account wrap in full instead of being truncated. Vue only: native N/A. It is a console component (wallet and red-packet admin tables and detail drawers, exported from both `@flare-im/vue-ui` and `@flare-im/vue-ui/admin`); no Flutter, SwiftUI or Compose app ships an admin console. See docs/admin-identity-and-icons.md.
notes.zh: 不是控件：没有悬停、焦点与点击。昵称与账号完整换行，不截断。仅 Vue，原生端 N/A：这是控制台组件（钱包、红包管理表格与详情抽屉，`@flare-im/vue-ui` 与 `@flare-im/vue-ui/admin` 都导出）；Flutter、SwiftUI、Compose 端没有任何 App 提供管理控制台。见 docs/admin-identity-and-icons.md。

accessibility.reducedMotionBehavior: No motion.
accessibility.screenReaderSemantics: Plain text: the nickname, then the account. The avatar is hidden from assistive technology because the name is already read; while loading the element is marked busy.

lexicon._note: 契约名 → 各端合法别名。平台惯用名不强改，但必须在此登记；validate 按此比对签名。

eventAliases._note: 契约事件 → 各端惯用回调名（除默认的 on+Pascal 派生外）。

messageLifecycle.source: UI projection mapped from authoritative host state; it does not replace or redefine the IM wire protocol.

composerActions._note: Composer 与附件动作面板统一 id（四端同名、无前缀）。默认集是「功能管理」里的内置功能，固定为 image、camera、video、file、voice、location、card（投票改由插件提供，PollComposer 与 VoteMessage 仍保留给历史消息），四端顺序与图标相同（defaultIcons），文案由各端 Kit 语言包按 id 提供（defaultLabels：Vue 为 i18n 键，原生为 FlareStrings 字段，Flutter 另有写法时记在 flutter），宿主可以不传 label；宿主列表整份替换默认集。kind 区分内置功能（feature）与插件入口（plugin），宿主可以不传。「+」项的 icon 不是注册表名时，四端都画 pluginFallbackIcon（Vue 另外：不带图标的统一 id 用 defaultIcons/各 id 的 Kit 图标，emoji 照文字画）。toolIds 是工具条工具 id，capabilities.availableToolIds 不传时全部显示，传了只显示列出的工具，attachments 即「+」按钮。

accessibilityContract.appliesTo: Every component with one or more contract events

desktopShell.sourceOfTruth: Spec + generated tokens + documented patterns; Vue PC is a reference implementation only.

accessibility.semantics: Expose localized name, role, value/state, availability, and progress. Decorative imagery is hidden.

responsiveNotes: Preserve content hierarchy and minimum target size
Allow long content and large text to reflow without overlap

platformDifferences.vue: ARIA and CSS focus-visible; pointer hover when available.
platformDifferences.flutter: Semantics, FocusTraversal, Shortcuts/Actions, and platform pointer conventions.
platformDifferences.compose: A kit-styled dropdown anchored in the trigger's Box, with Compose semantics.
platformDifferences.ios: The system pull-down Menu with fixed order; pressed items carry a check and the selected trait.

accessibility.semantics: Expose a named modal dialog (title or label); the content behind the scrim is inert.

responsiveNotes: Centered box clamped to the window minus twice spacing-xl
Short tasks use BottomSheet auto, which becomes this box off the phone form factor
Footer buttons trail on wide layouts and stack full width on narrow ones

platformDifferences.vue: Teleported role=dialog surface on the shared modal-surface stack; initial focus skips the header chrome and lands in the body.
platformDifferences.flutter: FlareModal replaces the former FlareDialog; FlareModal.show presents it on the root navigator, and a FlareModal placed directly in showDialog still centers itself.
platformDifferences.compose: Dialog window with the window dim off and a token scrim drawn instead; toasts render inside the topmost overlay window so they stay above it.
platformDifferences.ios: iOS 16.4+ full-screen cover with a clear background and a kit-drawn scrim; the system sheet's dim colour cannot be changed, so BottomSheet keeps the system dim while Modal and Drawer use colors.scrim.

accessibility.semantics: Expose a named modal dialog (title or label); the content behind the scrim is inert.
keyboard: Escape closes when dismissible, or goes back one page when showBack

responsiveNotes: Full-height panel at the inline end on wide layouts, clamped so a scrim gutter remains
A page on the phone form factor (Vue: full-width drawer)
Placement mirrors under RTL

platformDifferences.vue: Teleported role=dialog surface on the shared modal-surface stack; full width on the phone form factor instead of falling back to a page, because web hosts do not compute the form factor themselves.
platformDifferences.flutter: Root-navigator route with a nested Navigator: the scrim closes the whole stack while Escape and system back pop one page; showAdaptive pushes a page on the phone form factor.
platformDifferences.compose: Dialog window with the window dim off and a token scrim drawn instead; one BackHandler routes back to onBack or close, and the host picks page or drawer with flareCompactOverlays().
platformDifferences.ios: iOS 16.4+ full-screen cover with a clear background and a kit-drawn scrim and panel; falls back to a system sheet below 16.4 and on macOS, and to a pushed page in compact width when compactFallback is .push.

keyboard: Escape closes the nearest content overlay
Copy and media commands follow resolved capabilities

responsiveNotes: Constrain rich content to the bubble measure
Scroll code horizontally instead of widening the message lane
Use thumbnail-first media and native viewer presentation

platformDifferences.vue: Registry dispatch, selectable DOM text, browser media overlays.
platformDifferences.flutter: Typed content dispatch, SelectableText, native/router media presentation.
platformDifferences.compose: Typed content dispatch, Compose semantics, host-owned Android intents.

behavior.interaction: composes MessageStatus; only retryable failure is interactive

accessibility.semantics: Read timestamp and localized state names in visual order; decorative glyphs are hidden.
keyboard: Passive metadata does not enter focus order

responsiveNotes: Anchors to the bubble trailing edge
Keeps one line and fades low-priority text before overlapping content

platformDifferences.vue: Footer or media overlay placement is selected by MessageBubble.
platformDifferences.flutter: Row uses preformatted host timestamp and ambient text scale.
platformDifferences.compose: Row uses Compose text and semantics primitives.
platformDifferences.ios: HStack participates in Dynamic Type and native accessibility order.

visual.geometry: Sent uses one rounded path. Delivered and Read share one 16x16 two-path silhouette with 3 logical-pixel overlap, round caps and joins.

behavior.interaction: passive status; failed becomes retry control only when resend is supplied

accessibility.semantics: Expose the localized lifecycle state name; hide the drawn path. Failed with resend exposes a localized retry button.
keyboard: Passive states do not enter focus order
Enter or Space activates retry when available

responsiveNotes: Fixed intrinsic geometry never reflows
MessageMeta owns stable placement in bubbles

platformDifferences.vue: One currentColor SVG component.
platformDifferences.flutter: CustomPainter with snapped rounded strokes.
platformDifferences.compose: Canvas paths using LocalContentColor semantics.
platformDifferences.ios: SwiftUI Shape/Path using foregroundStyle.

keyboard: Focus moves to query on open
Home and End move to boundaries

responsiveNotes: Centered bounded dialog on desktop
Full-width safe-area sheet on compact mobile
Results remain lazy for large command sets

platformDifferences.vue: ARIA dialog/listbox with focus restoration and pointer hover.
platformDifferences.flutter: Semantics route with hardware keyboard navigation and Material focus.
platformDifferences.compose: Dialog and Compose key events; platform presentation may become a bottom sheet on compact Android.
platformDifferences.ios: SwiftUI modal content; native presentation and hardware keyboard commands are supplied by the host scene.
